```{r}
  print(n = Inf)

fig_contrib <- contrib %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(DATE, model), names_to = "driver", values_to = "contribution") %>%
  ggplot(aes(DATE, contribution, colour = driver)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = leafon_start, xmax = leafon_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#7AD151FF", alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Transpiration" = "#7AD151FF", "Rain (30 d)" = "#2A788EFF",
                                 "External (estuary W)" = "#440154FF")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Contribution to TR water-table level (m)", colour = NULL,
       caption = "Censored (Tobit) regression; green band: leaf-on") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 14))
print(fig_contrib)
ggsave("fig_TR_driver_contributions.png", fig_contrib, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# Leaf-on water balance: minimum water that had to leave the TR system (rain reaching the
# ground + water lost from the aquifer, at least from ~0 m to the sensor) compared with the
# measured stand transpiration. Daily means are compared, so unmeasured days are not filled.
leafon_days <- as.numeric(leafon_end - leafon_start + 1)
rain_leafon <- sum(drivers_all$rain[drivers_all$DATE >= leafon_start & drivers_all$DATE <= leafon_end],
                   na.rm = TRUE)
tibble(interception = c(0.10, 0.20)) %>%
  mutate(net_rain_mm         = rain_leafon * (1 - interception),
         aquifer_loss_min_mm = -tr_floor * sy * 1000,
         required_out_mm_d   = (net_rain_mm + aquifer_loss_min_mm) / leafon_days,
         stand_E_mm_d        = if (exists("E_stand"))
           mean(E_stand$E_mm[E_stand$DATE >= leafon_start & E_stand$DATE <= leafon_end]) else NA_real_,
         ratio_E_to_required = stand_E_mm_d / required_out_mm_d) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  print()
```

# Direct test: transpiration proxies vs CH4 by treatment

```{r}
# Q4. Does CH4 uptake respond to transpiration where roots are present?
#
# Hypothesis: in Control plots CH4 uptake increases with transpiration (the flux becomes
# more negative, so the slope is negative); in Root-free plots CH4 does not follow it.
# The treatment difference in CH4 is never used as a transpiration measure: transpiration
# comes only from the measured proxies (sap flux, MODIS GPP, stand transpiration).
#
# (a) Slope of CH4 on each proxy within each treatment (daily treatment medians), adjusted
#     for soil temperature, with continuous-time AR(1) errors for autocorrelation.
# (b) Within-day contrast: port and day fixed effects. Day effects absorb everything both
#     treatments share on a given day (season, temperature, water table, estuary, rain),
#     so the Control x proxy term is only the Control-specific response to transpiration.
#     95% CIs from a 14-day block bootstrap over days.
# (c) As (b), adding port-level SWC: if the term shrinks, transpiration acts on CH4
#     through soil moisture; if it stays, through another root pathway (e.g. aeration,
#     root exudates).
# Proxies are standardized (per SD) so they can be compared; the last table converts the
# Control x proxy term back to physical units.
n_boot_dfe <- 500

proxy_lab <- c(sap_mid   = "Sap flux (daily midday)",  sap_cum30 = "Sap flux (30-d mean)",
               gpp       = "MODIS GPP (8-day)",        gpp_cum30 = "MODIS GPP (30-d mean)",
               E_mean30  = "Stand transpiration (30-d mean)")
proxy_units <- c(sap_mid = "F units", sap_cum30 = "F units", gpp = "g C m-2 d-1",
                 gpp_cum30 = "g C m-2 d-1", E_mean30 = "mm d-1")
proxy_vars <- intersect(names(proxy_lab), names(drivers_wt))   # E_mean30 only if chunk "Stand transpiration" ran

ch4_pd <- ch4_all %>%
  left_join(drivers_wt %>% dplyr::select(DATE, all_of(proxy_vars)), by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end) %>%
  mutate(ctrl = as.numeric(Treat == "Control"), PORT = factor(PORT))

# (a) Within-treatment slopes. Spearman rho is reported as an assumption-free check.
trt_day <- ch4_pd %>%
  group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
  summarise(fch4 = median(fch4), ts = median(ts), swc = median(swc),
            across(all_of(proxy_vars), dplyr::first), .groups = "drop")

slope_fit <- function(trt, pv) {
  d <- trt_day %>%
    filter(Treat == trt) %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, fch4, ts, x = all_of(pv)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    arrange(DATE) %>%
    mutate(x_z = z(x), ts_z = z(ts), day_num = as.numeric(DATE - min(DATE)))
  m <- tryCatch(nlme::gls(fch4 ~ x_z + ts_z, correlation = nlme::corCAR1(form = ~ day_num),
                          data = d, control = nlme::glsControl(opt = "optim")),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  tt <- if (is.null(m)) matrix(NA, 1, 4, dimnames = list("x_z", c("Value", "Std.Error", "t-value", "p-value")))
        else summary(m)$tTable
  tibble(proxy = proxy_lab[[pv]], Treat = trt, n_days = nrow(d),
         spearman_rho = cor(d$x, d$fch4, method = "spearman"),
         slope_umol_per_sd = tt["x_z", "Value"], se = tt["x_z", "Std.Error"], p_gls = tt["x_z", "p-value"])
}

slopes_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(trt = c("Control", "Root-free"), pv = proxy_vars) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(slope_fit) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 4)))
print(slopes_tbl, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# (b) and (c) Within-day contrast. The bootstrap resamples 14-day blocks of days; a
# block drawn twice is kept as separate days so each copy gets its own day effect.
prep_dfe <- function(pv, data = ch4_pd) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, PORT, Treat, ctrl, fch4, ts, swc, x = all_of(pv)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    mutate(x_z = z(x), ts_z = z(ts), swc_z = z(swc), fDATE = factor(DATE))
}

# No ctrl main effect: it is constant within port and already absorbed by PORT.
# I() keeps a fixed coefficient name, whatever the term order in the formula.
dfe_coef <- function(d, with_swc = FALSE) {
  form <- if (with_swc) fch4 ~ PORT + fDATE + ts_z + I(ctrl * ts_z) + I(ctrl * x_z) + swc_z + I(ctrl * swc_z)
          else          fch4 ~ PORT + fDATE + ts_z + I(ctrl * ts_z) + I(ctrl * x_z)
  coef(lm(form, data = d))[["I(ctrl * x_z)"]]
}

block_boot_days <- function(d, fun, R = n_boot_dfe, block = cv_block_days) {
  days   <- sort(unique(d$DATE))
  blocks <- split(days, ceiling(seq_along(days) / block))
  replicate(R, {
    pick <- sample(seq_along(blocks), length(blocks), replace = TRUE)
    db <- purrr::map2_dfr(blocks[pick], seq_along(pick), function(b, i)
      d %>% filter(DATE %in% b) %>% mutate(fDATE = factor(paste(i, DATE))))
    fun(db)
  })
}

dfe_fit <- function(pv, with_swc) {
  d   <- prep_dfe(pv)
  est <- dfe_coef(d, with_swc)
  set.seed(42)
  bt <- block_boot_days(d, function(x) dfe_coef(x, with_swc))
  tibble(proxy = proxy_lab[[pv]], pv = pv,
         model = if (with_swc) "(c) + SWC (direct effect)" else "(b) total effect",
         interaction_umol_per_sd = est,
         ci_low  = quantile(bt, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
         ci_high = quantile(bt, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
         p_boot  = min(1, 2 * min(mean(bt >= 0, na.rm = TRUE), mean(bt <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))),
         one_sd  = sd(d$x), n_days = n_distinct(d$DATE))
}

interaction_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(pv = proxy_vars, with_swc = c(FALSE, TRUE)) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(dfe_fit) %>%
  mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high))
print(interaction_tbl %>% dplyr::select(-pv, -one_sd) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))),
      n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Same term in physical units: change in the Control-minus-Root-free CH4 flux per unit of
# the proxy (dividing by 1 SD of the proxy in the sample used).
interaction_tbl %>%
  transmute(proxy, model, one_sd = signif(one_sd, 3), units = proxy_units[pv],
            umol_per_unit = signif(interaction_umol_per_sd / one_sd, 3),
            ci_low_unit   = signif(ci_low / one_sd, 3),
            ci_high_unit  = signif(ci_high / one_sd, 3)) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

fig_ch4_proxy <- trt_day %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(any_of(c("sap_cum30", "gpp_cum30", "E_mean30")), names_to = "proxy", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(proxy = dplyr::recode(proxy, !!!proxy_lab)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, fch4, colour = Treat)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ proxy, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = bquote(CH[4] ~ "flux" ~ (mu*mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1})), colour = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 14))
print(fig_ch4_proxy)
ggsave("fig_ch4_vs_transpiration_proxy.png", fig_ch4_proxy, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Causal tests: randomization, placebo, Granger and window sensitivity

```{r}
# Q4b. Is the Control-specific response of CH4 to transpiration (chunk "Direct test")
# robust, or could it arise by chance or from a shared seasonal trend?
#
# 1) Randomization (Fisher) test: the interaction is refitted for all 70 ways of calling
#    4 of the 8 ports "Control". With 8 ports the smallest possible one-sided p is 1/70 = 0.014.
#    It needs no distributional assumption and respects that the port is the replicate.
# 2) Placebos that should show no effect: spring leaf-off only (no transpiration yet), and
#    the proxy 30 days in the future (residualized on today's value, so it carries only
#    future information; a real effect cannot run backwards in time).
# 3) Granger-type precedence: do past changes in transpiration predict today's change in
#    CH4 beyond past CH4 and temperature? The reverse direction is the check. Newey-West
#    (HAC) errors handle the remaining autocorrelation.
# 4) Per-port slopes: how many of the 4 Control ports show the negative slope.
# 5) Window sensitivity: 30 days is a choice, so all pre-set windows (7-60 d) are reported,
#    for the whole period and from leaf-out, plus one global test across windows that
#    avoids picking the best window. Windows use measured days only (roll_mean_obs).
# Needs ch4_pd, trt_day, proxy_lab, prep_dfe() from "Direct test".
p_load(lmtest, sandwich)

ports       <- levels(ch4_pd$PORT)
true_ctrl   <- ch4_pd %>% distinct(PORT, ctrl) %>% { setNames(.$ctrl, as.character(.$PORT)) }
assignments <- purrr::map(combn(ports, 4, simplify = FALSE), ~ setNames(as.numeric(ports %in% .x), ports))

# Point estimate of the Control x proxy term for a given port assignment (same model as (b)).
interaction_est <- function(d, ctrl_vec) {
  d$ctrl <- ctrl_vec[as.character(d$PORT)]
  coef(lm(fch4 ~ PORT + fDATE + ts_z + I(ctrl * ts_z) + I(ctrl * x_z), data = d))[["I(ctrl * x_z)"]]
}

# Shared randomization helper: stat() maps a port assignment to a number. One-sided p
# follows H1 (more uptake in Control = more negative); the tolerance absorbs rounding.
perm_test <- function(stat) {
  obs  <- stat(true_ctrl)
  perm <- vapply(assignments, stat, numeric(1))
  tibble(estimate = obs,
         p_one_sided = mean(perm <= obs + 1e-12),
         p_two_sided = mean(abs(perm) >= abs(obs) - 1e-12),
         rank = sum(perm <= obs + 1e-12), n_assignments = length(perm))
}

# 1) Randomization test for every proxy.
rand_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(names(proxy_lab)[names(proxy_lab) %in% names(ch4_pd)], function(pv) {
  d <- prep_dfe(pv)
  perm_test(function(a) interaction_est(d, a)) %>% mutate(proxy = proxy_lab[[pv]], .before = 1)
}) %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(rand_tbl, width = Inf)

# 2) Placebos. Too few days or a constant proxy (e.g. no sap data in spring) returns NA.
placebo_test <- function(pv, type) {
  d <- if (type == "spring leaf-off") {
    prep_dfe(pv, filter(ch4_pd, DATE < leafon_start))
  } else {
    future <- drivers_wt %>% transmute(DATE = DATE - 30, x_future = .data[[pv]])
    ch4_pd %>%
      left_join(future, by = "DATE") %>%
      dplyr::select(DATE, PORT, fch4, ts, x_now = all_of(pv), x = x_future) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na() %>%
      mutate(x_z = z(resid(lm(x ~ x_now))), ts_z = z(ts), fDATE = factor(DATE))
  }
  out <- tibble(proxy = proxy_lab[[pv]], placebo = type, n_days = n_distinct(d$DATE))
  if (nrow(d) < 50 || !is.finite(sd(d$x_z)) || sd(d$x_z) == 0) return(out)
  bind_cols(out, perm_test(function(a) interaction_est(d, a)))
}
placebo_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(pv = intersect(c("sap_cum30", "gpp_cum30", "E_mean30"), names(ch4_pd)),
                                  type = c("spring leaf-off", "proxy 30 d in the future")) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(placebo_test) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(placebo_tbl, width = Inf)

# 3) Granger test on daily changes, per treatment. Missing days stay missing (complete()
# only inserts the rows), so changes and lags are never computed across gaps.
granger_hac <- function(trt, pv, reverse, lags = 3) {
  d <- trt_day %>%
    filter(Treat == trt) %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, fch4, ts, x = all_of(pv)) %>%
    tidyr::complete(DATE = seq(min(DATE), max(DATE), by = "day")) %>%
    arrange(DATE) %>%
    mutate(y = fch4 - dplyr::lag(fch4), xx = x - dplyr::lag(x), dts = ts - dplyr::lag(ts))
  if (reverse) d <- mutate(d, tmp = y, y = xx, xx = tmp)
  for (k in seq_len(lags)) d[[paste0("y_l", k)]] <- dplyr::lag(d$y, k)
  for (k in seq_len(lags)) d[[paste0("x_l", k)]] <- dplyr::lag(d$xx, k)
  d  <- tidyr::drop_na(d, y, dts, starts_with("y_l"), starts_with("x_l"))
  m0 <- lm(reformulate(c("dts", paste0("y_l", seq_len(lags))), "y"), data = d)
  m1 <- update(m0, reformulate(c(".", paste0("x_l", seq_len(lags))), "."))
  w  <- lmtest::waldtest(m0, m1, vcov = sandwich::NeweyWest(m1, prewhite = FALSE))
  tibble(Treat = trt, proxy = proxy_lab[[pv]], direction = if (reverse) "CH4 -> proxy" else "proxy -> CH4",
         n_days = nrow(d), F = w$F[2], p = w$`Pr(>F)`[2])
}
# Daily sap flux only: GPP is constant within each 8-day composite, so its daily changes
# are mostly zero and cannot show day-to-day precedence.
granger_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(trt = c("Control", "Root-free"), pv = "sap_mid", reverse = c(FALSE, TRUE)) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(granger_hac) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(granger_tbl, width = Inf)

# 4) Per-port slopes (temperature-adjusted). The Wilcoxon test is the 4 vs 4 version of
# the randomization test, easier to report.
port_slopes <- tidyr::expand_grid(pv = intersect(c("sap_cum30", "gpp_cum30", "E_mean30"), names(ch4_pd)),
                                  port = ports) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(pv, port) {
    d <- prep_dfe(pv) %>% filter(PORT == port)
    tibble(proxy = proxy_lab[[pv]], PORT = port, Treat = as.character(d$Treat[1]),
           slope_umol_per_sd = coef(lm(fch4 ~ x_z + ts_z, data = d))[["x_z"]], n_days = nrow(d))
  })
print(port_slopes %>% arrange(proxy, Treat, PORT), n = Inf)

port_slopes %>%
  group_by(proxy) %>%
  summarise(control_negative  = sum(slope_umol_per_sd[Treat == "Control"] < 0),
            rootfree_negative = sum(slope_umol_per_sd[Treat == "Root-free"] < 0),
            median_control    = median(slope_umol_per_sd[Treat == "Control"]),
            median_rootfree   = median(slope_umol_per_sd[Treat == "Root-free"]),
            p_wilcox = wilcox.test(slope_umol_per_sd ~ Treat, exact = TRUE)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

# 5) Window sensitivity. Means over k days of measured values (NA if < 80% of the window
# was measured). GPP is an 8-day step series, so its windows are always complete.
windows   <- c(7, 14, 21, 30, 45, 60)
periods   <- c("full period", "from leaf-out")
win_proxy <- c(`Sap flux` = "sap_mid", `MODIS GPP` = "gpp")

win_tbl <- drivers_all %>% arrange(DATE) %>% dplyr::select(DATE, all_of(unname(win_proxy)))
for (p in names(win_proxy)) for (k in windows) {
  win_tbl[[paste(p, k)]] <- roll_mean_obs(win_tbl[[win_proxy[[p]]]], k)
}

ch4_win <- ch4_pd %>%
  dplyr::select(DATE, PORT, Treat, ctrl, fch4, ts, swc) %>%
  left_join(win_tbl %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(unname(win_proxy))), by = "DATE")

prep_win <- function(proxy, k, period) {
  dat <- if (period == "from leaf-out") filter(ch4_win, DATE >= leafon_start) else ch4_win
  dat %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, PORT, Treat, fch4, ts, x = all_of(paste(proxy, k))) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    mutate(x_z = z(x), ts_z = z(ts), fDATE = factor(DATE))
}

sens_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(proxy = names(win_proxy), k = windows, period = periods) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(proxy, k, period) {
    d <- prep_win(proxy, k, period)
    slopes <- d %>% group_by(PORT, Treat) %>%
      summarise(slope = coef(lm(fch4 ~ x_z + ts_z))[["x_z"]], .groups = "drop")
    perm_test(function(a) interaction_est(d, a)) %>%
      mutate(proxy = proxy, window_days = k, period = period, n_days = n_distinct(d$DATE),
             control_ports_negative  = sum(slopes$slope[slopes$Treat == "Control"] < 0),
             rootfree_ports_negative = sum(slopes$slope[slopes$Treat == "Root-free"] < 0),
             .before = 1)
  }) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, p_one_sided, p_two_sided), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(sens_tbl, n = Inf, width = Inf)

fig_sens <- sens_tbl %>%
  mutate(sig = if_else(p_one_sided <= 0.05, "p <= 0.05", "p > 0.05")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(window_days, estimate, colour = proxy)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ period) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("p <= 0.05" = 16, "p > 0.05" = 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Sap flux" = "#7AD151FF", "MODIS GPP" = "#2A788EFF")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = windows) +
  labs(x = "Averaging window (days)",
       y = bquote("Control x proxy interaction on" ~ CH[4] ~ "(" * mu*mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1} ~ "per SD)"),
       colour = NULL, shape = "Randomization test (one-sided)") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 13))
print(fig_sens)
ggsave("fig_sensitivity_window.png", fig_sens, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# Global test: the statistic is the mean interaction across all six windows, so a single
# p-value covers every window and no window is selected after seeing the results.
global_tbl <- tidyr::expand_grid(proxy = names(win_proxy), period = periods) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(proxy, period) {
    d_list <- purrr::map(windows, ~ prep_win(proxy, .x, period))
    perm_test(function(a) mean(vapply(d_list, interaction_est, numeric(1), ctrl_vec = a))) %>%
      mutate(proxy = proxy, period = period, .before = 1)
  }) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(global_tbl, width = Inf)
```


# Path analysis (SEM): direct and indirect effects of transpiration on CH4

```{r}
# Q6. How much of the transpiration effect on CH4 passes through the water table and soil
# moisture, and does that pathway exist only where roots are present?
#
# Why a path model: the predictors depend on each other (transpiration lowers the water
# table, the water table sets soil moisture, soil moisture sets CH4), so a single regression
# splits their shared variance arbitrarily. A structural equation model (SEM, lavaan; as in
# Tang et al. 2025, GCB) writes that dependence explicitly as a chain of regressions and
# returns, for each response, its R2 and, for each driver, the direct effect, the indirect
# effect through the mediators and the share of the total effect that is mediated.
#
# Assumed causal structure:
#   water table <- transpiration + rain (30 d and 7 d) + estuary level (W)
#   SWC         <- transpiration + water table + rain (7 d and 30 d) + soil temperature
#   CH4         <- SWC + water table + transpiration + soil temperature
# Paths added after the first fit, following the modification indices and only where
# physically justified (Tang et al. 2025): recent rain raises the water table (gwl <- rain_7d);
# antecedent rain keeps the surface soil wet (swc <- rain_30d); warmer soil dries faster by
# evaporation (swc <- ts). Suggested paths without a mechanism (e.g. water table <- SWC,
# CH4 <- estuary level) were not added.
# Multi-group model: the same structure is fitted to Control and Root-free together. The
# water-table equation is constrained to be equal (both treatments share one water table);
# the SWC and CH4 paths are free, so the treatments are compared path by path. The
# treatment difference is never used as a transpiration measure: transpiration comes only
# from the proxies.
#
# Procedure follows Tang et al. (2025): data screening (missing data, skewness, kurtosis,
# collinearity, residual linearity and homoscedasticity, positive definiteness), robust
# maximum likelihood (MLR) on standardized variables, and fit judged by CFI, TLI, RMSEA and
# SRMR (good: CFI and TLI >= 0.95, RMSEA <= 0.06, SRMR <= 0.08). Differences from Tang:
# daily data with only measured days (no gap filling) and a block bootstrap for the CIs.
#
# Limits to report: the structure is assumed, not tested; the TR water table is capped at
# the sensor (-0.49 m), which weakens the transpiration -> water-table path; daily values
# are autocorrelated, so CIs come from a 14-day block bootstrap over days, not from lavaan.
p_load(lavaan, car)

n_boot_sem <- 500
sem_proxy  <- c(`Sap flux (30-d mean)` = "sap_cum30", `MODIS GPP (30-d mean)` = "gpp_cum30")

sem_model <- '
  gwl  ~ c(t_wt, t_wt) * transp + rain_30d + rain_7d + W
  swc  ~ c(t_sw_C, t_sw_R) * transp + c(wt_sw_C, wt_sw_R) * gwl + rain_7d + rain_30d + ts
  fch4 ~ c(sw_ch_C, sw_ch_R) * swc + c(wt_ch_C, wt_ch_R) * gwl + c(t_ch_C, t_ch_R) * transp + ts

  # Effects of transpiration on CH4, per treatment (C = Control, R = Root-free)
  via_swc_C    := t_sw_C * sw_ch_C
  via_swc_R    := t_sw_R * sw_ch_R
  via_wt_C     := t_wt * (wt_ch_C + wt_sw_C * sw_ch_C)
  via_wt_R     := t_wt * (wt_ch_R + wt_sw_R * sw_ch_R)
  indirect_C   := via_swc_C + via_wt_C
  indirect_R   := via_swc_R + via_wt_R
  total_C      := t_ch_C + indirect_C
  total_R      := t_ch_R + indirect_R

  # Root effect on each pathway: Control minus Root-free
  diff_t_swc    := t_sw_C - t_sw_R
  diff_wt_swc   := wt_sw_C - wt_sw_R
  diff_swc_ch4  := sw_ch_C - sw_ch_R
  diff_indirect := indirect_C - indirect_R
  diff_total    := total_C - total_R
  
  # Total effect of transpiration on SWC (direct + through the water table), per treatment
  total_sw_C   := t_sw_C + t_wt * wt_sw_C
  total_sw_R   := t_sw_R + t_wt * wt_sw_R
  diff_total_sw := total_sw_C - total_sw_R
'

# Daily table per treatment (median across ports). All variables are standardized over
# both treatments together, so coefficients are comparable between groups.
sem_data <- function(pv) {
  resp_daily %>%
    transmute(DATE, Treat = factor(Treat, levels = c("Control", "Root-free")),
              fch4, swc, ts, gwl = gwl_cens, W, rain_7d, rain_30d, transp = .data[[pv]]) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    mutate(across(c(fch4, swc, ts, gwl, W, rain_7d, rain_30d, transp), z))
}

# Data screening (Tang et al. 2025, Supporting Information), per proxy and treatment.
# The three equations of the model are fitted as ordinary regressions to check them.
sem_equations <- list(gwl = gwl ~ transp + rain_30d + rain_7d + W,
                      swc = swc ~ transp + gwl + rain_7d + rain_30d + ts,
                      fch4 = fch4 ~ swc + gwl + transp + ts)
sem_vars <- c("fch4", "swc", "ts", "gwl", "W", "rain_7d", "rain_30d", "transp")

screen_sem <- function(pv, proxy_name) {
  d <- sem_data(pv)
  # Skewness (|x| > 1 = high) and excess kurtosis (|x| > 2 = too peaked or flat).
  shape <- d %>%
    group_by(Treat) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(sem_vars), list(
      skew = ~ mean(.x^3) / mean(.x^2)^1.5,
      kurt = ~ mean(.x^4) / mean(.x^2)^2 - 3)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Treat, names_to = c("variable", ".value"), names_sep = "_(?=skew|kurt)")
  # Collinearity: VIF > 10 is extreme. Positive definiteness: all eigenvalues of the
  # covariance matrix > 0.
  checks <- d %>%
    group_by(Treat) %>%
    group_modify(~ tibble(
      max_vif = max(unlist(lapply(sem_equations[c("swc", "fch4")], function(f) car::vif(lm(f, data = .x))))),
      min_eigen = min(eigen(cov(.x[sem_vars]))$values),
      n_days = nrow(.x))) %>%
    ungroup()
  # Residuals vs fitted for each equation (linearity: no curve; homoscedasticity: no funnel).
  res <- d %>%
    group_by(Treat) %>%
    group_modify(~ purrr::imap_dfr(sem_equations, function(f, eq) {
      m <- lm(f, data = .x); tibble(equation = eq, fitted = fitted(m), resid = resid(m))
    })) %>%
    ungroup()
  print(ggplot(res, aes(fitted, resid)) +
          geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red") +
          geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "blue") +
          facet_grid(Treat ~ equation, scales = "free") +
          labs(title = paste("Residuals vs fitted:", proxy_name), x = "Fitted", y = "Residual") +
          theme(panel.grid = element_blank()))
  cat("\n", proxy_name, "\n")
  print(shape %>% mutate(across(c(skew, kurt), ~ round(.x, 2))), n = Inf)
  print(checks %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))))
}
purrr::iwalk(sem_proxy, screen_sem)

# Robust maximum likelihood (MLR): Huber-White standard errors and a scaled test statistic,
# because daily fluxes are skewed and residual variance is not constant.
# lavaan needs a plain data.frame: on a tibble it cannot read the group column and warns
# that the group labels do not appear. Group order follows the factor levels
# (1 = Control, 2 = Root-free), which matches the order of the labels in sem_model.
fit_sem <- function(d) sem(sem_model, data = as.data.frame(d), group = "Treat", estimator = "MLR")

# Block bootstrap over days: the same days are drawn for both treatments, so their
# shared day-to-day conditions stay paired.
# Labelled estimates of a fit as a named vector (each label once; shared labels such as
# t_wt appear in both groups with the same value).
labelled_est <- function(fit) {
  pe <- parameterEstimates(fit)
  x  <- setNames(pe$est, pe$label)
  x[names(x) != "" & !duplicated(names(x))]
}

boot_sem <- function(d, R = n_boot_sem) {
  # Days are kept as text: unlist() on a list of Dates drops the Date class and the
  # day lookup below would then find no rows.
  days     <- sort(unique(as.character(d$DATE)))
  blocks   <- split(days, ceiling(seq_along(days) / cv_block_days))
  rows_day <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), as.character(d$DATE))
  set.seed(42)
  draws <- replicate(R, {
    pick <- unlist(blocks[sample(seq_along(blocks), length(blocks), replace = TRUE)])
    fit  <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(fit_sem(d[unlist(rows_day[pick]), ])), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) NULL else labelled_est(fit)
  }, simplify = FALSE)
  bind_rows(purrr::map(purrr::compact(draws), ~ as_tibble(as.list(.x))))
}

sem_results <- purrr::imap(sem_proxy, function(pv, proxy_name) {
  d   <- sem_data(pv)
  fit <- fit_sem(d)
  bt  <- boot_sem(d)
  est <- labelled_est(fit)
  # Modification indices: the omitted paths that would most improve the fit. Only paths
  # with a physical justification may be added (Tang et al. 2025).
  cat("\n", proxy_name, "- largest modification indices\n")
  print(modindices(fit, sort. = TRUE, maximum.number = 8)[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "group", "mi", "epc")])
  list(
    n_days = n_distinct(d$DATE),
    fit    = fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "pvalue.scaled",
                                "cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr")),
    r2     = lavInspect(fit, "r2"),
    paths  = tibble(proxy = proxy_name, label = names(est), estimate = unname(est),
                    ci_low  = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    n_boot  = nrow(bt)) %>%
      mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high)))
})

# Model fit (good: CFI and TLI >= 0.95, RMSEA <= 0.06, SRMR <= 0.08; poor: CFI or TLI < 0.90,
# RMSEA or SRMR > 0.10; Hu & Bentler 1999) and
# variance explained (R2) of each response, per treatment.
purrr::imap(sem_results, function(r, proxy_name) {
  cat("\n", proxy_name, "| days:", r$n_days, "\n")
  print(round(r$fit, 3))
  print(lapply(r$r2, round, 2))
}) %>% invisible()

# Paths and effects with 95% block-bootstrap CIs (standardized units).
sem_tbl <- bind_rows(purrr::map(sem_results, "paths")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(sem_tbl, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Share of the total transpiration effect on CH4 that is mediated (indirect / total).
# Only meaningful when the total effect is clearly different from zero.
sem_tbl %>%
  filter(label %in% c("indirect_C", "indirect_R", "total_C", "total_R")) %>%
  mutate(Treat = if_else(str_ends(label, "_C"), "Control", "Root-free"),
         part  = str_remove(label, "_[CR]$")) %>%
  dplyr::select(proxy, Treat, part, estimate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = part, values_from = estimate) %>%
  mutate(pct_mediated = round(100 * indirect / total)) %>%
  print()
```

# Path analysis robustness: port randomization and atmospheric demand

```{r}
# Q6b. Is the SEM result robust to (1) which ports are called Control and (2) atmospheric
# demand acting on the water table independently of the trees?
#
# (1) Port randomization. The SEM uses the daily median of the 4 ports of each treatment,
# so a treatment difference could come from one unusual port (e.g. the port-6 hot spot)
# instead of the roots. The SEM is refitted for all 70 ways of calling 4 of the 8 ports
# "Control"; the observed Control - Root-free difference is ranked among them. With 8
# ports the smallest possible one-sided p is 1/70 = 0.014 (same logic as "Causal tests").
# (2) Atmospheric demand. The transpiration proxies rise with vapour pressure deficit, which
# also drives soil evaporation. VPD (30-d mean of the daily maximum) is added to the water-
# table and SWC equations; if the transpiration -> water-table path and the treatment
# difference persist, they are not only atmospheric demand.
# Needs sem_model, sem_proxy, labelled_est(), fit_sem() from "Path analysis (SEM)".

ports_all  <- sort(unique(as.character(ch4_all$PORT)))
port_treat <- ch4_all %>% distinct(PORT = as.character(PORT), Treat = as.character(Treat))
sem_assignments <- combn(ports_all, 4, simplify = FALSE)
true_control    <- sort(port_treat$PORT[port_treat$Treat == "Control"])

# Port-level daily data (SWC from all valid SWC days, CH4 and soil temperature from the
# flux days) and the drivers shared by all ports.
port_daily <- full_join(swc_daily %>% transmute(DATE, PORT = as.character(PORT), swc),
                        ch4_all  %>% transmute(DATE, PORT = as.character(PORT), fch4, ts),
                        by = c("DATE", "PORT"))
sem_drivers <- drivers_all %>%
  arrange(DATE) %>%
  mutate(vpd = roll_mean_obs(vpd_max, 30)) %>%
  dplyr::select(DATE, rain_7d, rain_30d, vpd, all_of(unname(sem_proxy))) %>%
  left_join(wt_daily %>% dplyr::select(DATE, gwl = gwl_cens, W), by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end)

# Daily medians for a given set of "Control" ports (the rest are "Root-free"), standardized
# over both groups together, exactly as in the main SEM.
assign_data <- function(control_ports, pv, extra = character(0)) {
  port_daily %>%
    mutate(Treat = factor(if_else(PORT %in% control_ports, "Control", "Root-free"),
                          levels = c("Control", "Root-free"))) %>%
    group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
    summarise(swc = median(swc, na.rm = TRUE), fch4 = median(fch4, na.rm = TRUE),
              ts = median(ts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(sem_drivers %>% mutate(transp = .data[[pv]]), by = "DATE") %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, fch4, swc, ts, gwl, W, rain_7d, rain_30d, transp, all_of(extra)) %>%
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x) & !is.nan(.x))) %>%
    mutate(across(-c(DATE, Treat), z))
}

perm_sem <- function(pv, proxy_name) {
  stats <- purrr::map_dfr(sem_assignments, function(a) {
    fit <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(fit_sem(assign_data(a, pv))), error = function(e) NULL)
    est <- if (is.null(fit)) NULL else labelled_est(fit)
    tibble(control_ports = paste(a, collapse = "-"),
           is_true = identical(sort(a), true_control),
           diff_total  = if (is.null(est)) NA_real_ else est[["diff_total"]],
           diff_wt_swc = if (is.null(est)) NA_real_ else est[["diff_wt_swc"]])
  })
  obs <- filter(stats, is_true)
  # One-sided p in the direction of the hypothesis: more uptake in Control (diff_total < 0)
  # and stronger water-table -> SWC coupling in Control (diff_wt_swc > 0).
  tibble(proxy = proxy_name,
         n_assignments = sum(!is.na(stats$diff_total)),
         diff_total_obs   = obs$diff_total,
         p_diff_total     = mean(stats$diff_total <= obs$diff_total + 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE),
         rank_diff_total  = sum(stats$diff_total <= obs$diff_total + 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE),
         diff_wt_swc_obs  = obs$diff_wt_swc,
         p_diff_wt_swc    = mean(stats$diff_wt_swc >= obs$diff_wt_swc - 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE),
         rank_diff_wt_swc = sum(stats$diff_wt_swc >= obs$diff_wt_swc - 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE))
}

perm_sem_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(sem_proxy, perm_sem) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(perm_sem_tbl, width = Inf)

# (2) Same SEM with VPD in the water-table and SWC equations (labels v_wt, v_sw_*).
sem_model_vpd <- sem_model %>%
  sub("gwl  ~ c(t_wt, t_wt) * transp +", "gwl  ~ c(t_wt, t_wt) * transp + c(v_wt, v_wt) * vpd +", ., fixed = TRUE) %>%
  sub("gwl + rain_7d + rain_30d + ts", "gwl + rain_7d + rain_30d + ts + c(v_sw_C, v_sw_R) * vpd", ., fixed = TRUE)
stopifnot(grepl("v_wt", sem_model_vpd), grepl("v_sw_C", sem_model_vpd))

fit_sem_vpd <- function(d) sem(sem_model_vpd, data = as.data.frame(d), group = "Treat", estimator = "MLR")

boot_sem_vpd <- function(d, R = n_boot_sem) {
  days     <- sort(unique(as.character(d$DATE)))
  blocks   <- split(days, ceiling(seq_along(days) / cv_block_days))
  rows_day <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), as.character(d$DATE))
  set.seed(42)
  draws <- replicate(R, {
    pick <- unlist(blocks[sample(seq_along(blocks), length(blocks), replace = TRUE)])
    fit  <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(fit_sem_vpd(d[unlist(rows_day[pick]), ])), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) NULL else labelled_est(fit)
  }, simplify = FALSE)
  bind_rows(purrr::map(purrr::compact(draws), ~ as_tibble(as.list(.x))))
}

key_terms <- c("t_wt", "v_wt", "wt_sw_C", "wt_sw_R", "total_C", "total_R", "diff_wt_swc", "diff_total")
vpd_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(sem_proxy, function(pv, proxy_name) {
  d   <- assign_data(true_control, pv, extra = "vpd")
  fit <- fit_sem_vpd(d)
  bt  <- boot_sem_vpd(d)
  est <- labelled_est(fit)[key_terms]
  cat("\n", proxy_name, "+ VPD | days:", n_distinct(d$DATE), "\n")
  print(round(fitMeasures(fit, c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr")), 3))
  tibble(proxy = proxy_name, label = key_terms, estimate_with_vpd = unname(est),
         ci_low  = purrr::map_dbl(key_terms, ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
         ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(key_terms, ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
         n_boot  = nrow(bt))
}) %>%
  left_join(sem_tbl %>% dplyr::select(proxy, label, estimate_without_vpd = estimate), by = c("proxy", "label")) %>%
  mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high),
         across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  relocate(estimate_without_vpd, .after = label)
print(vpd_tbl, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```


# Path diagram (SEM)

```{r}
# Path diagram of the SEM in the style of Tang et al. (2025, Fig. 8): one panel per
# treatment, arrows coloured by sign (blue positive, red negative), width proportional to
# the standardized coefficient, solid when the 95% block-bootstrap CI excludes zero and
# dashed grey otherwise. R2 of each response is printed under its box. Rain, estuary level
# and soil temperature were in the model as covariates and are listed in the caption.
# Needs sem_tbl and sem_results from "Path analysis (SEM)".

diagram_proxy <- "Sap flux (30-d mean)"   # or "MODIS GPP (30-d mean)"

nodes <- tibble(node = c("Transpiration", "Water table", "SWC", "CH4"),
                x = c(0, 1.6, 1.6, 3.2), y = c(0, 1, -1, 0),
                r2_key = c(NA, "gwl", "swc", "fch4"))

edges <- tribble(
  ~from,           ~to,           ~Control,  ~`Root-free`,
  "Transpiration", "Water table", "t_wt",    "t_wt",
  "Transpiration", "SWC",         "t_sw_C",  "t_sw_R",
  "Water table",   "SWC",         "wt_sw_C", "wt_sw_R",
  "SWC",           "CH4",         "sw_ch_C", "sw_ch_R",
  "Water table",   "CH4",         "wt_ch_C", "wt_ch_R",
  "Transpiration", "CH4",         "t_ch_C",  "t_ch_R") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Control, `Root-free`), names_to = "Treat", values_to = "label") %>%
  left_join(filter(sem_tbl, proxy == diagram_proxy), by = "label") %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% dplyr::select(from = node, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "from") %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% dplyr::select(to = node, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "to") %>%
  # Shorten each arrow by 22% at both ends so it starts and stops at the box edges.
  mutate(xs = x0 + 0.22 * (x1 - x0), ys = y0 + 0.22 * (y1 - y0),
         xe = x1 - 0.22 * (x1 - x0), ye = y1 - 0.22 * (y1 - y0),
         xm = (x0 + x1) / 2, ym = (y0 + y1) / 2 + if_else(y0 == y1, 0.12, 0),
         sig    = ci_excludes_0,
         colour = case_when(!sig ~ "n.s.", estimate > 0 ~ "positive", TRUE ~ "negative"),
         txt    = sprintf("%.2f", estimate))

node_lab <- tidyr::expand_grid(Treat = c("Control", "Root-free"), nodes) %>%
  mutate(r2 = purrr::map2_dbl(Treat, r2_key, function(tr, k)
           if (is.na(k)) NA_real_ else sem_results[[diagram_proxy]]$r2[[tr]][[k]]),
         lab = if_else(is.na(r2), node, sprintf("%s\nR² = %.2f", node, r2)))

fig_sem <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = edges,
               aes(x = xs, y = ys, xend = xe, yend = ye, colour = colour,
                   linewidth = abs(estimate), linetype = sig),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_label(data = edges, aes(xm, ym, label = txt, colour = colour), size = 3.6,
             label.size = 0, fill = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = node_lab, aes(x, y, label = lab), size = 4, fill = "grey95",
             label.padding = unit(0.35, "lines")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Treat) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(positive = "#2166AC", negative = "#B2182B", `n.s.` = "grey60"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.4, 2.8), guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "solid", `FALSE` = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 3.7), ylim = c(-1.4, 1.4)) +
  labs(caption = paste0(
    "Transpiration proxy: ", diagram_proxy, ". Standardized coefficients; solid = 95% block-bootstrap CI excludes 0.\n",
    "Covariates: rain (7 d, 30 d) and estuary level on the water table; rain and soil temperature on SWC; ",
    "soil temperature on CH4.")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"), legend.position = "top",
        text = element_text(size = 13), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10))
print(fig_sem)
ggsave("fig_SEM_path_diagram.png", fig_sem, width = 12, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
# Leave-one-port-out sensitivity

```{r}
# Q6c. Does the lack of significance of the net treatment difference come from one atypical
# port (e.g. the spring CH4 hot spot in port 6) rather than from the absence of an effect?
#
# Each port is removed in turn and the randomization tests are repeated with the remaining
# 7 ports, keeping the real group sizes (3 vs 4): C(7, 3) = 35 assignments, so the smallest
# possible one-sided p is 1/35 = 0.029. Tested statistics:
#   - SEM: net transpiration effect on CH4 (diff_total, H1 < 0) and water-table -> SWC
#     coupling (diff_wt_swc, H1 > 0), Control minus Root-free;
#   - Direct test: Control x 30-d sap flux interaction with port and day effects (H1 < 0).
# This is a sensitivity analysis decided after seeing the results: the main result is the
# one with all 8 ports, and this table only shows how much each port drives it.
# Needs port_daily, sem_drivers, fit_sem(), labelled_est(), true_control (SEM robustness)
# and prep_dfe(), interaction_est() (Direct test and Causal tests).

lopo_proxy <- "sap_cum30"   # 30-d mean sap flux, the main proxy

# Daily medians for a set of "Control" ports, using only the ports in `pd`.
assign_data_from <- function(pd, control_ports, pv) {
  pd %>%
    mutate(Treat = factor(if_else(PORT %in% control_ports, "Control", "Root-free"),
                          levels = c("Control", "Root-free"))) %>%
    group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
    summarise(swc = median(swc, na.rm = TRUE), fch4 = median(fch4, na.rm = TRUE),
              ts = median(ts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(sem_drivers %>% mutate(transp = .data[[pv]]), by = "DATE") %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, fch4, swc, ts, gwl, W, rain_7d, rain_30d, transp) %>%
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x) & !is.nan(.x))) %>%
    mutate(across(-c(DATE, Treat), z))
}

# One-sided randomization p and rank of the observed value among all assignments.
rank_p <- function(perm, obs, lower = TRUE) {
  hits <- if (lower) perm <= obs + 1e-12 else perm >= obs - 1e-12
  c(p = mean(hits, na.rm = TRUE), rank = sum(hits, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(perm)))
}

d_direct_all <- prep_dfe(lopo_proxy)

lopo_one <- function(drop_port) {
  keep      <- setdiff(ports_all, drop_port)
  ctrl_real <- intersect(true_control, keep)
  assigns   <- combn(keep, length(ctrl_real), simplify = FALSE)
  pd        <- filter(port_daily, PORT %in% keep)

  # SEM statistics for every assignment of the remaining ports.
  sem_stats <- purrr::map_dfr(assigns, function(a) {
    fit <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(fit_sem(assign_data_from(pd, a, lopo_proxy))), error = function(e) NULL)
    est <- if (is.null(fit)) NULL else labelled_est(fit)
    tibble(is_true = setequal(a, ctrl_real),
           diff_total  = if (is.null(est)) NA_real_ else est[["diff_total"]],
           diff_wt_swc = if (is.null(est)) NA_real_ else est[["diff_wt_swc"]])
  })
  obs_sem <- filter(sem_stats, is_true)

  # Direct-test interaction for every assignment of the remaining ports.
  d_dir <- d_direct_all %>% filter(as.character(PORT) %in% keep) %>% droplevels()
  dir_stat <- function(a) interaction_est(d_dir, setNames(as.numeric(keep %in% a), keep))
  dir_perm <- vapply(assigns, dir_stat, numeric(1))
  dir_obs  <- dir_stat(ctrl_real)

  r_tot <- rank_p(sem_stats$diff_total, obs_sem$diff_total, lower = TRUE)
  r_wt  <- rank_p(sem_stats$diff_wt_swc, obs_sem$diff_wt_swc, lower = FALSE)
  r_dir <- rank_p(dir_perm, dir_obs, lower = TRUE)
  tibble(dropped_port = drop_port,
         dropped_treat = port_treat$Treat[port_treat$PORT == drop_port],
         n_assignments = length(assigns),
         sem_diff_total = obs_sem$diff_total, p_diff_total = r_tot[["p"]], rank_diff_total = r_tot[["rank"]],
         sem_diff_wt_swc = obs_sem$diff_wt_swc, p_diff_wt_swc = r_wt[["p"]], rank_diff_wt_swc = r_wt[["rank"]],
         direct_interaction = dir_obs, p_direct = r_dir[["p"]], rank_direct = r_dir[["rank"]])
}

# Reference row with all 8 ports (70 assignments), from the earlier chunks.
all_ports_row <- tibble(
  dropped_port = "none", dropped_treat = "-", n_assignments = 70L,
  sem_diff_total  = perm_sem_tbl$diff_total_obs[perm_sem_tbl$proxy == names(sem_proxy)[sem_proxy == lopo_proxy]],
  p_diff_total    = perm_sem_tbl$p_diff_total[perm_sem_tbl$proxy == names(sem_proxy)[sem_proxy == lopo_proxy]],
  sem_diff_wt_swc = perm_sem_tbl$diff_wt_swc_obs[perm_sem_tbl$proxy == names(sem_proxy)[sem_proxy == lopo_proxy]],
  p_diff_wt_swc   = perm_sem_tbl$p_diff_wt_swc[perm_sem_tbl$proxy == names(sem_proxy)[sem_proxy == lopo_proxy]])

lopo_tbl <- bind_rows(all_ports_row, purrr::map_dfr(ports_all, lopo_one)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(sem_diff_total, sem_diff_wt_swc, direct_interaction), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         across(starts_with("p_"), ~ round(.x, 3)))
print(lopo_tbl, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Figure: one-sided p of each test when each port is removed (dashed line: p = 0.05;
# dotted line: smallest possible p with 7 ports, 1/35).
fig_lopo <- lopo_tbl %>%
  filter(dropped_port != "none") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(p_diff_total, p_diff_wt_swc, p_direct), names_to = "test", values_to = "p") %>%
  mutate(test = dplyr::recode(test,
                              p_diff_total  = "SEM: net effect on CH4",
                              p_diff_wt_swc = "SEM: water table -> SWC coupling",
                              p_direct      = "Direct test: Control x sap flux"),
         port = paste0("Port ", dropped_port, "\n(", dropped_treat, ")")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(port, p, colour = test, group = test)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1 / 35, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#7AD151FF", "#2A788EFF", "#440154FF")) +
  labs(x = "Port removed", y = "Randomization p (one-sided)", colour = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 13))
print(fig_lopo)
ggsave("fig_leave_one_port_out.png", fig_lopo, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
