# Water-table thresholds for the transpiration effect

```{r}
# Q7. Below which water-table depth does the transpiration -> SWC -> CH4 chain start to act?
#
# Idea: while the water table is shallow, capillary rise keeps the surface soil wet whatever
# the trees do; once it drops below some depth, the surface soil dries and CH4 uptake rises.
# Three steps, each fitted per treatment on daily treatment medians:
#   (a) SWC vs water table: breakpoint where SWC starts to follow the water table
#       (segmented regression; Muggeo 2003);
#   (b) CH4 vs SWC (adjusted for soil temperature): breakpoint where drier soil starts to
#       increase uptake;
#   (c) transpiration effect on CH4 as a function of water-table depth (transpiration x
#       water-table interaction): the depths at which that effect is clearly different from
#       zero (Johnson-Neyman interval).
# Breakpoint CIs come from a 14-day block bootstrap (daily values are autocorrelated).
# Limit: days with the water table below the sensor (-0.49 m) are excluded from (a) and (c),
# so any threshold deeper than -0.49 m cannot be detected.
p_load(segmented)

n_boot_thr <- 500

thr_df <- resp_daily %>%
  transmute(DATE, Treat, fch4, swc, ts, gwl = gwl_cens, transp = sap_cum30) %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end)

# Breakpoint fit: returns the breakpoint, the slopes on each side and Davies' test p
# (H0: no change in slope). NULL when no breakpoint can be estimated.
fit_break <- function(d, form, z) {
  m0  <- lm(form, data = d)
  seg <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(segmented(m0, seg.Z = reformulate(z), psi = median(d[[z]]))),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(seg) || is.null(seg$psi)) return(NULL)
  sl <- slope(seg)[[z]]
  list(psi = unname(seg$psi[1, "Est."]), slope_low = sl[1, "Est."], slope_high = sl[2, "Est."],
       p_davies = davies.test(m0, seg.Z = reformulate(z))$p.value)
}

block_boot_break <- function(d, form, z, R = n_boot_thr) {
  days   <- sort(unique(as.character(d$DATE)))
  blocks <- split(days, ceiling(seq_along(days) / cv_block_days))
  set.seed(42)
  replicate(R, {
    pick <- unlist(blocks[sample(seq_along(blocks), length(blocks), replace = TRUE)])
    db   <- d[match(pick, as.character(d$DATE)), ]
    b    <- fit_break(db, form, z)
    if (is.null(b)) NA_real_ else b$psi
  })
}

break_table <- function(form, z, label, data) {
  purrr::map_dfr(c("Control", "Root-free"), function(tr) {
    d <- data %>% filter(Treat == tr) %>% dplyr::select(DATE, all_of(all.vars(form))) %>% tidyr::drop_na()
    b <- fit_break(d, form, z)
    if (is.null(b)) return(tibble(relation = label, Treat = tr, n_days = nrow(d)))
    bt <- block_boot_break(d, form, z)
    tibble(relation = label, Treat = tr, n_days = nrow(d),
           breakpoint = b$psi, ci_low = quantile(bt, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), ci_high = quantile(bt, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
           slope_below = b$slope_low, slope_above = b$slope_high, p_davies = b$p_davies)
  })
}

# (a) SWC vs water table (m, relative to the ground), measured water-table days only.
# (b) CH4 vs SWC, adjusted for soil temperature, all days.
break_tbl <- bind_rows(
  break_table(swc ~ gwl, "gwl", "SWC vs water table (m)", filter(thr_df, gwl > tr_floor)),
  break_table(fch4 ~ swc + ts, "swc", "CH4 vs SWC (m3 m-3)", thr_df)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, 3)))
print(break_tbl, width = Inf)

# (c) Transpiration effect on CH4 conditional on the water-table depth. GLS with CAR(1)
# errors; the conditional slope at depth g is b_transp + b_interaction * g, with its SE from
# the coefficient covariance. Transpiration and temperature are standardized; the water
# table stays in metres so the depths can be read directly.
jn_curve <- function(tr) {
  d <- thr_df %>% filter(Treat == tr, gwl > tr_floor) %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, fch4, transp, gwl, ts) %>% tidyr::drop_na() %>% arrange(DATE) %>%
    mutate(transp_z = z(transp), ts_z = z(ts), day_num = as.numeric(DATE - min(DATE)))
  m <- nlme::gls(fch4 ~ transp_z * gwl + ts_z, correlation = nlme::corCAR1(form = ~ day_num),
                 data = d, control = nlme::glsControl(opt = "optim"))
  b <- coef(m); V <- vcov(m)
  tibble(Treat = tr, gwl = seq(min(d$gwl), max(d$gwl), length.out = 100)) %>%
    mutate(slope = b[["transp_z"]] + b[["transp_z:gwl"]] * gwl,
           se    = sqrt(V["transp_z", "transp_z"] + gwl^2 * V["transp_z:gwl", "transp_z:gwl"] +
                          2 * gwl * V["transp_z", "transp_z:gwl"]),
           lo = slope - 1.96 * se, hi = slope + 1.96 * se,
           significant = sign(lo) == sign(hi),
           p_interaction = summary(m)$tTable["transp_z:gwl", "p-value"])
}
jn <- purrr::map_dfr(c("Control", "Root-free"), jn_curve)

# Depth ranges where the transpiration effect on CH4 is clearly negative (more uptake).
jn %>%
  filter(significant, slope < 0) %>%
  group_by(Treat) %>%
  summarise(shallowest_m = max(gwl), deepest_m = min(gwl), p_interaction = first(p_interaction), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

fig_thr_a <- thr_df %>% filter(gwl > tr_floor) %>%
  ggplot(aes(gwl, swc, colour = Treat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(break_tbl, relation == "SWC vs water table (m)"),
             aes(xintercept = breakpoint, colour = Treat), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  labs(x = "Water table (m, relative to ground)", y = bquote("SWC" ~ (m^3 ~ m^{-3})), colour = NULL, title = "(a)")

fig_thr_b <- thr_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(swc, fch4, colour = Treat)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(break_tbl, relation == "CH4 vs SWC (m3 m-3)"),
             aes(xintercept = breakpoint, colour = Treat), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  labs(x = bquote("SWC" ~ (m^3 ~ m^{-3})), y = bquote(CH[4] ~ (mu*mol ~ m^{-2} ~ s^{-1})), colour = NULL, title = "(b)")

fig_thr_c <- ggplot(jn, aes(gwl, slope, colour = Treat, fill = Treat)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = treatment_colors) + scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  labs(x = "Water table (m, relative to ground)",
       y = bquote("Effect of transpiration on" ~ CH[4] ~ "(per SD)"), colour = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "(c)")

fig_thr <- (fig_thr_a | fig_thr_b | fig_thr_c) + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 12))
print(fig_thr)
ggsave("fig_water_table_thresholds.png", fig_thr, width = 14, height = 4.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")


```

# Fix 1: treatment values from complete days (all 4 ports)

```{r fix1-complete-ports}
# Fix 1. Daily treatment values from complete days only.
#
# Problem: resp_daily, trt_day and the SEM use the median of whatever ports were valid
# that day. When one port drops out (n_obs filter, missing CH4), the median jumps
# without any change in the soil, and dswc (Q2b) turns those jumps into fake changes.
# Here: (a) levels use only days on which every port of the treatment is present;
# (b) SWC changes are computed per port (consecutive days only) and aggregated after,
# again only on days with a change for every port.
# Needs swc_daily, ch4_all, drivers_wt, dry_dates, partition(), gls_std(), grid,
# hydro_level, hydro_change, proxies, partition_tbl, resp_change ("Setup" and "RF").

# Number of ports per treatment (expected 4 and 4)
n_ports <- swc_daily %>% distinct(Treat, PORT) %>% count(Treat, name = "n_ports_trt")
print(n_ports)

# Keep a (DATE, Treat) group only when every port of the treatment is in it.
keep_complete <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    left_join(n_ports, by = "Treat") %>%
    group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(PORT) == first(n_ports_trt)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-n_ports_trt)
}

# (a) Levels: SWC and CH4 medians on complete days only.
swc_4p <- swc_daily %>%
  keep_complete() %>%
  group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
  summarise(swc = median(swc), .groups = "drop")
ch4_4p <- ch4_all %>%
  keep_complete() %>%
  group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
  summarise(fch4 = median(fch4), ts = median(ts), .groups = "drop")

resp_daily_4p <- swc_4p %>%
  full_join(ch4_4p, by = c("DATE", "Treat")) %>%
  left_join(drivers_wt, by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end)

# (b) Changes: per port first (consecutive days only), then the median across ports.
swc_change_port <- swc_daily %>%
  arrange(PORT, DATE) %>%
  group_by(PORT) %>%
  mutate(dswc = if_else(as.numeric(DATE - lag(DATE)) == 1, swc - lag(swc), NA_real_)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(dswc))

resp_change_4p <- swc_change_port %>%
  keep_complete() %>%
  group_by(DATE, Treat) %>%
  summarise(dswc_spread = sd(dswc),          # disagreement among ports (diagnostic)
            dswc = median(dswc), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(drivers_wt, by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end, DATE %in% dry_dates)

# How many days are kept, per treatment (old = any number of ports).
bind_rows(
  resp_daily     %>% filter(!is.na(swc))  %>% count(Treat, name = "n") %>% mutate(series = "SWC level", version = "old"),
  resp_daily_4p  %>% filter(!is.na(swc))  %>% count(Treat, name = "n") %>% mutate(series = "SWC level", version = "4 ports"),
  resp_daily     %>% filter(!is.na(fch4)) %>% count(Treat, name = "n") %>% mutate(series = "CH4", version = "old"),
  resp_daily_4p  %>% filter(!is.na(fch4)) %>% count(Treat, name = "n") %>% mutate(series = "CH4", version = "4 ports"),
  resp_change    %>% filter(!is.na(dswc)) %>% count(Treat, name = "n") %>% mutate(series = "SWC change (dry days)", version = "old"),
  resp_change_4p %>% count(Treat, name = "n") %>% mutate(series = "SWC change (dry days)", version = "4 ports")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = n) %>%
  print()

# Size of the composition artefact: old change of the median vs new median of the
# port changes, on the dates both versions have.
resp_change %>%
  dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, dswc_old = dswc) %>%
  inner_join(resp_change_4p %>% dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, dswc_new = dswc), by = c("DATE", "Treat")) %>%
  group_by(Treat) %>%
  summarise(n_days = n(), r = cor(dswc_old, dswc_new, use = "complete.obs"),
            sd_old = sd(dswc_old, na.rm = TRUE), sd_new = sd(dswc_new),
            sd_difference = sd(dswc_old - dswc_new, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

# Rerun Q2, Q2b and Q3 with the complete-day series (same labels as before, so the
# results can be matched to partition_tbl).
q2_4p <- purrr::pmap_dfr(grid, function(pname, trt, wt) {
  p <- proxies[[pname]]
  partition(filter(resp_daily_4p, Treat == trt), "swc",
            transp = c(p$cum, p$day, "vpd_max"), hydro = hydro_level[[wt]],
            label = paste("SWC", trt, "|", pname, "| WT", wt))
})
q2b_4p <- purrr::pmap_dfr(grid, function(pname, trt, wt) {
  p <- proxies[[pname]]
  partition(filter(resp_change_4p, Treat == trt), "dswc",
            transp = c(p$day, "vpd_max"), hydro = hydro_change[[wt]],
            label = paste("SWC change (dry days)", trt, "|", pname, "| WT", wt))
})
q3_4p <- tidyr::expand_grid(grid, with_swc = c(FALSE, TRUE)) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(pname, trt, wt, with_swc) {
    p <- proxies[[pname]]
    partition(filter(resp_daily_4p, Treat == trt), "fch4",
              transp = c(p$cum, p$day, "vpd_max"), hydro = hydro_level[[wt]],
              base = if (with_swc) c("ts", "swc") else "ts",
              label = paste("CH4", trt, "|", pname, "| WT", wt, if (with_swc) "| + SWC" else ""))
  })

partition_4p <- bind_rows(q2_4p, q2b_4p, q3_4p) %>%
  mutate(across(c(r2_full, unique_transp, unique_hydro, shared, covariates), ~ round(.x, 3)))

# Old vs complete-day partitions, side by side.
partition_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(model, n_days, r2_full, unique_transp, unique_hydro, shared) %>%
  inner_join(partition_4p %>% dplyr::select(model, n_days, r2_full, unique_transp, unique_hydro, shared),
             by = "model", suffix = c("_old", "_4p")) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Q2b direction and size (GLS with CAR1), Control, complete-day changes.
q2b_coef_4p <- tidyr::expand_grid(pname = names(proxies), wt = wt_versions) %>%
  purrr::pmap_dfr(function(pname, wt) {
    wt_terms <- if (wt == "filled") c("gwl_fill", "dgwl_fill") else c("gwl_cens", "dgwl_cens")
    gls_std(filter(resp_change_4p, Treat == "Control"), "dswc",
            c(proxies[[pname]]$day, "vpd_max", wt_terms, "dW"),
            paste("SWC change Control |", pname, "| WT", wt))
  })
print(q2b_coef_4p)
```

# Fix 2: transpiration -> water table with censored (Tobit) regression

```{r fix2-tobit-path}
# Fix 2. Path model with the water-table link fitted as censored (Tobit) regression.
#
# Problem: the SEM used gwl_cens (60 days set to -0.49 m) as if it were a continuous
# variable, which flattens the drawdown and biases the transpiration -> water-table path.
# Here the model is split into its equations (piecewise path model):
# (A) water table <- transpiration + rain (30 d, 7 d) + estuary (W): Tobit, censored at
#     the sensor, ONE row per day (the single TR well is shared by both treatments, so it
#     is not duplicated per treatment as in the multigroup SEM);
# (B) SWC  <- transpiration + water table + rain (7 d, 30 d) + soil temperature, per treatment;
# (C) CH4  <- SWC + water table + transpiration + soil temperature, per treatment.
# (B) and (C) need a water-table value on censored days: here the gap-filled TR (TR_best,
# an estimate of the latent level, same units as the Tobit). Fix 3 replaces it with the
# whole ensemble so its uncertainty is carried forward.
# Units are physical, not standardized: transpiration per SD of the proxy, water table in m,
# SWC in m3 m-3, CH4 in umol m-2 s-1. Indirect effects are products of paths, as in the SEM.
# CIs: 14-day block bootstrap by calendar block (same days drawn for both treatments).
# Needs resp_daily_4p (Fix 1), drivers_all, wb_daily, fit_tobit() ("Water table ... censored
# regression"), sem_proxy, z(), tr_floor, cv_block_days.
n_boot_path <- 500

# Day table for (A) and treatment table for (B, C). The proxy is standardized once, on
# the day table, and the same values are used in every equation.
path_data <- function(pv, resp = resp_daily_4p) {
  day_all <- drivers_all %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, rain_7d, rain_30d, x = all_of(pv)) %>%
    left_join(wb_daily %>% dplyr::select(DATE, TR, W), by = "DATE") %>%
    filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(x, rain_7d, rain_30d, W) %>%
    mutate(transp = z(x), TR_c = pmax(TR, tr_floor))
  trt <- resp %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, swc, fch4, ts, gwl = gwl_fill) %>%
    inner_join(day_all %>% dplyr::select(DATE, transp, rain_7d, rain_30d, W), by = "DATE") %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()
  list(day = tidyr::drop_na(day_all, TR_c), trt = trt)
}

# All paths and effects for one data set. Labels follow the SEM (C = Control, R = Root-free).
path_terms <- function(day_d, trt_d) {
  tob <- fit_tobit(TR_c ~ transp + rain_30d + rain_7d + W, day_d)
  t_wt <- coef(tob)[["transp"]]
  out <- c(t_wt = t_wt)
  for (tr in c("Control", "Root-free")) {
    k <- if (tr == "Control") "C" else "R"
    d <- filter(trt_d, Treat == tr)
    b_sw <- coef(lm(swc ~ transp + gwl + rain_7d + rain_30d + ts, data = d))
    b_ch <- coef(lm(fch4 ~ swc + gwl + transp + ts, data = d))
    t_sw <- b_sw[["transp"]]; wt_sw <- b_sw[["gwl"]]
    sw_ch <- b_ch[["swc"]]; wt_ch <- b_ch[["gwl"]]; t_ch <- b_ch[["transp"]]
    via_wt <- t_wt * (wt_ch + wt_sw * sw_ch)
    indirect <- t_sw * sw_ch + via_wt
    out[paste0(c("t_sw_", "wt_sw_", "sw_ch_", "wt_ch_", "t_ch_",
                 "total_sw_", "via_wt_", "indirect_", "total_"), k)] <-
      c(t_sw, wt_sw, sw_ch, wt_ch, t_ch, t_sw + t_wt * wt_sw, via_wt, indirect, t_ch + indirect)
  }
  out[["diff_t_sw"]]     <- out[["t_sw_C"]]     - out[["t_sw_R"]]
  out[["diff_wt_sw"]]    <- out[["wt_sw_C"]]    - out[["wt_sw_R"]]
  out[["diff_total_sw"]] <- out[["total_sw_C"]] - out[["total_sw_R"]]
  out[["diff_indirect"]] <- out[["indirect_C"]] - out[["indirect_R"]]
  out[["diff_total"]]    <- out[["total_C"]]    - out[["total_R"]]
  out
}

# Block bootstrap by calendar block. With gwl_ens (Fix 3), every replicate also draws one
# member of the gap-fill ensemble for the water table used in (B) and (C).
boot_path <- function(day_d, trt_d, R = n_boot_path, gwl_ens = NULL) {
  day_d$blk <- as.integer(day_d$DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days
  trt_d$blk <- as.integer(trt_d$DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days
  blks <- sort(unique(day_d$blk))
  rows_day <- split(seq_len(nrow(day_d)), day_d$blk)
  rows_trt <- split(seq_len(nrow(trt_d)), trt_d$blk)
  set.seed(42)
  draws <- replicate(R, {
    pick <- as.character(sample(blks, length(blks), replace = TRUE))
    dd <- day_d[unlist(rows_day[pick]), ]
    td <- trt_d[unlist(rows_trt[pick]), ]
    if (!is.null(gwl_ens)) {
      k <- sample(ncol(gwl_ens$values), 1)
      td$gwl <- gwl_ens$values[match(td$DATE, gwl_ens$DATE), k]
      td <- tidyr::drop_na(td, gwl)
    }
    tryCatch(suppressWarnings(path_terms(dd, td)), error = function(e) NULL)
  }, simplify = FALSE)
  bind_rows(purrr::map(purrr::compact(draws), ~ as_tibble(as.list(.x))))
}

path_units <- c(t_wt = "m per SD", t_sw = "m3 m-3 per SD", wt_sw = "m3 m-3 per m",
                sw_ch = "umol m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3", wt_ch = "umol m-2 s-1 per m",
                t_ch = "umol m-2 s-1 per SD", total_sw = "m3 m-3 per SD",
                via_wt = "umol m-2 s-1 per SD", indirect = "umol m-2 s-1 per SD",
                total = "umol m-2 s-1 per SD")

summarise_path <- function(est, bt, proxy_name, pd) {
  tibble(proxy = proxy_name, label = names(est), estimate = unname(est),
         ci_low  = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
         ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
         n_boot = nrow(bt), n_days_tobit = nrow(pd$day),
         n_censored = sum(pd$day$TR_c <= tr_floor), n_days_trt = n_distinct(pd$trt$DATE)) %>%
    mutate(units = unname(path_units[sub("^diff_", "", sub("_[CR]$", "", label))]),
           ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high))
}

path_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(sem_proxy, function(pv, proxy_name) {
  pd <- path_data(pv)
  summarise_path(path_terms(pd$day, pd$trt), boot_path(pd$day, pd$trt), proxy_name, pd)
})
print(path_tbl %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Link (A) alone, with and without VPD (30-d mean of the daily max), so the water-table
# path can be compared with the multigroup SEM and with the earlier Tobit models.
tob_link_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(sem_proxy, function(pv, proxy_name) {
  d <- path_data(pv)$day %>%
    left_join(drivers_all %>% arrange(DATE) %>%
                transmute(DATE, vpd30 = roll_mean_obs(vpd_max, 30)), by = "DATE") %>%
    mutate(vpd_z = z(vpd30))
  bind_rows(
    tob_boot(TR_c ~ transp + rain_30d + rain_7d + W, d) %>% mutate(model = "A"),
    tob_boot(TR_c ~ transp + rain_30d + rain_7d + W + vpd_z, d) %>% mutate(model = "A + VPD")) %>%
    mutate(proxy = proxy_name)
}) %>%
  filter(term %in% c("transp", "vpd_z")) %>%
  mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high)) %>%
  relocate(proxy, model)
print(tob_link_tbl %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 3))), width = Inf)

# Comparison with the restricted window: GPP on the sap-flux days only. If the GPP
# effect disappears here, it came from the summer vs winter contrast (season), not from
# variation in canopy activity within the growing season.
gpp_sapdays <- path_data("gpp_cum30")$day %>%
  semi_join(path_data("sap_cum30")$day, by = "DATE") %>%
  mutate(transp = z(x))
tob_boot(TR_c ~ transp + rain_30d + rain_7d + W, gpp_sapdays) %>%
  filter(term == "transp") %>%
  mutate(model = "A | MODIS GPP on sap-flux days only") %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

# Fix 3: carry the gap-fill uncertainty forward

```{r fix3-propagate-gapfill}
# Fix 3. Carry the uncertainty of the gap-filled TR water table into the analyses.
#
# Problem: the gap-filled series (median CI width ~0.47 m) entered the RF and the path
# models as one fixed series (TR_best), so its uncertainty was ignored. Also, in the
# original ensemble the cap at the sensor was applied after the simulation, so the days
# after a censored day started from values above the sensor.
# Here: (1) the ensemble is rebuilt with the censoring applied inside the simulation (on a
# censored day the residual is redrawn until the level is at or below the sensor; if no
# draw qualifies, the level is set to the sensor); (2) the path model of Fix 2 is
# bootstrapped with one ensemble member drawn per replicate, so its CIs include both
# sampling and gap-fill uncertainty; (3) the RF partitions with the filled water table
# are repeated over n_mi ensemble members.
# Needs wb_daily, m_full, cf_draws, block_noise(), n_sims, res_block, tr_floor ("TR
# water-balance model"), and path_data(), path_terms(), boot_path(), summarise_path(),
# path_tbl (Fix 2), resp_daily_4p, grid, proxies, hydro_level, partition() (Fix 1 and RF).
n_redraw <- 50    # residual redraws allowed on a censored day
n_mi <- 10        # ensemble members for the RF (each takes a few minutes; 20+ for the paper)

# (1) Water-balance simulation with the censoring inside the loop. Same equation as
# simulate_tr(): check that the last term (d + noise[i]) matches the original.
simulate_tr_cens <- function(df, cf, noise = rep(0, nrow(df)), res = numeric(0)) {
  a <- cf[["rain"]]; b <- -cf[["grad_prev"]]; d <- cf[["(Intercept)"]]
  c_et <- if ("et" %in% names(cf)) -cf[["et"]] else 0
  cens <- !is.na(df$TR) & !df$tr_obs           # known to be at or below the sensor
  sim <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (df$tr_obs[i]) { sim[i] <- df$TR[i]; next }
    if (i == 1 || is.na(sim[i - 1])) next
    if (anyNA(c(df$rain[i], df$down[i - 1]))) { sim[i] <- sim[i - 1]; next }
    et_i <- if (is.na(df$et[i])) 0 else df$et[i]
    base <- sim[i - 1] + a * df$rain[i] - b * (sim[i - 1] - df$down[i - 1]) - c_et * et_i + d
    sim[i] <- base + noise[i]
    if (cens[i] && sim[i] > tr_floor) {
      alt <- base + sample(res, n_redraw, replace = TRUE)
      ok <- alt[alt <= tr_floor]
      sim[i] <- if (length(ok) > 0) ok[1] else tr_floor
    }
  }
  sim
}

res_full <- residuals(m_full)
set.seed(42)
ens_c <- vapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(k)
  simulate_tr_cens(wb_daily, cf_draws[k, ],
                   noise = block_noise(res_full, nrow(wb_daily), res_block), res = res_full),
  numeric(nrow(wb_daily)))
gwl_ens <- list(DATE = wb_daily$DATE, values = ens_c)

# Old (capped after) vs new (censored inside) ensemble, on the filled days of the study.
q_new <- apply(ens_c, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
tibble(DATE = wb_daily$DATE, filled = !wb_daily$tr_obs,
       old_median = q[2, ], old_width = q[3, ] - q[1, ],
       new_median = q_new[2, ], new_width = q_new[3, ] - q_new[1, ]) %>%
  filter(filled, DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end) %>%
  group_by(month = floor_date(DATE, "month")) %>%
  summarise(n_filled = n(), across(c(old_median, new_median, old_width, new_width),
                                   ~ round(median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 3)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# (2) Path model with the gap-fill uncertainty in the bootstrap.
path_tbl_mi <- purrr::imap_dfr(sem_proxy, function(pv, proxy_name) {
  pd <- path_data(pv)
  # point estimate from the median of the new ensemble (observed days are unchanged)
  pd$trt$gwl <- q_new[2, match(pd$trt$DATE, gwl_ens$DATE)]
  pd$trt <- tidyr::drop_na(pd$trt, gwl)
  summarise_path(path_terms(pd$day, pd$trt),
                 boot_path(pd$day, pd$trt, gwl_ens = gwl_ens), proxy_name, pd)
})

# CIs without (Fix 2) and with (Fix 3) the gap-fill uncertainty, side by side.
path_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(proxy, label, units, estimate, ci_low, ci_high, ci_excludes_0) %>%
  left_join(path_tbl_mi %>% dplyr::select(proxy, label, ci_low, ci_high, ci_excludes_0),
            by = c("proxy", "label"), suffix = c("_fixed_wt", "_with_gapfill")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

# (3) RF partitions with the filled water table, repeated over ensemble members.
# Each member replaces gwl_fill; the spread of the R2 components across members is the
# gap-fill uncertainty of the partition (the censored version does not use the fill).
set.seed(42)
mi_members <- sample(seq_len(n_sims), n_mi)
grid_filled <- filter(grid, wt == "filled")

rf_mi <- purrr::map_dfr(mi_members, function(k) {
  rd <- resp_daily_4p %>%
    dplyr::select(-gwl_fill) %>%
    left_join(tibble(DATE = gwl_ens$DATE, gwl_fill = gwl_ens$values[, k]), by = "DATE")
  swc_k <- purrr::pmap_dfr(grid_filled, function(pname, trt, wt) {
    p <- proxies[[pname]]
    partition(filter(rd, Treat == trt), "swc",
              transp = c(p$cum, p$day, "vpd_max"), hydro = hydro_level[[wt]],
              label = paste("SWC", trt, "|", pname, "| WT", wt))
  })
  ch4_k <- tidyr::expand_grid(grid_filled, with_swc = c(FALSE, TRUE)) %>%
    purrr::pmap_dfr(function(pname, trt, wt, with_swc) {
      p <- proxies[[pname]]
      partition(filter(rd, Treat == trt), "fch4",
                transp = c(p$cum, p$day, "vpd_max"), hydro = hydro_level[[wt]],
                base = if (with_swc) c("ts", "swc") else "ts",
                label = paste("CH4", trt, "|", pname, "| WT", wt, if (with_swc) "| + SWC" else ""))
    })
  bind_rows(swc_k, ch4_k) %>% mutate(member = k)
})

# Mean and 95% range across members, next to the single-series result (Fix 1).
rf_mi %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(r2_full, unique_transp, unique_hydro, shared),
                      names_to = "component", values_to = "r2") %>%
  group_by(model, component) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(r2), low = quantile(r2, 0.025), high = quantile(r2, 0.975),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(partition_4p %>%
              tidyr::pivot_longer(c(r2_full, unique_transp, unique_hydro, shared),
                                  names_to = "component", values_to = "single_series"),
            by = c("model", "component")) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, component, single_series, mean, low, high) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

# Control-well approach: local drawdown of the TR water table

```{r control-well}
# Control-well (paired-well) approach. Question: how much of the leaf-on drawdown of the
# TR water table is NOT explained by external hydrology, and does that local part follow
# tree transpiration?
#
# WTE and W respond to the same rain, estuary and barrier as TR but have few or no trees.
# (1) Calibrate TR on WTE, W, rain and barrier state on leaf-off days only, when the trees
#     do not transpire. Tobit, censored at the TR sensor (-0.49 m).
# (2) Predict TR for leaf-on: the level TR would have from external hydrology alone.
# (3) Local deficit = observed - predicted. On censored days only a bound is known
#     (deficit <= floor - predicted), so the deficit is treated as left-censored.
# (4) Tests: (a) level: deficit vs 30-d mean sap flux (censored regression); (b) daily:
#     change in deficit vs daily midday sap flux, consecutive rain-free days with TR above
#     the sensor; (c) mean deficit in the measured window (leaf-out to obs_end, before the
#     TR fell below the sensor) and at peak leaf-on (mostly censored bounds).
# (5) Water check: mean deficit x Sy vs cumulative stand transpiration since leaf-out.
# (6) Placebo: WTE predicted from W. A WTE deficit as large as in TR would mean the TR
#     deficit is not specific to the forest.
# (7) Calibration in changes (more stable than levels): dTR ~ dWTE + dW + rain on leaf-off
#     days, applied to leaf-on; the local change is observed - predicted change, and its
#     running sum is the local drawdown, valid only until TR first falls below the sensor.
# CIs: 14-day calendar-block bootstrap that refits the calibration in every replicate.
# Limits: if the trees also lower WTE, the deficit underestimates the tree effect
# (conservative); W carries marsh transpiration, so it is not a no-vegetation control.
# Needs wb_daily, drivers_all, barrier_days, dry_dates, E_stand, m_full, fit_tobit(), z(),
# tr_floor, leafon_start, leafon_end, peak_start, peak_end, cv_block_days.
#
# Rain enters the main calibration ("rain"): TR rises far more per mm of rain than WTE or
# W, so without rain every storm appears as a positive deficit. met_daily ends on
# 2024-12-31, so the "rain" version is calibrated on 2024 leaf-off days only; "no rain"
# uses the whole well record (adds Jan-Apr 2025) as a sensitivity check.
# barrier_open_d (open that day) was dropped: learned from the months-long winter opening,
# it created spikes on the 1-2 day summer openings. open_30d keeps the barrier state.
p_load(survival, patchwork)
n_boot_cw <- 500
calib_end <- as.Date("2025-05-01")             # last leaf-off day of 2025 (before leaf-out)
obs_end <- as.Date("2024-08-10")               # end of the measured leaf-on window (TR above sensor)
sy <- 0.001 / coef(m_full)[["rain"]]           # specific yield from the water-balance model
cw_forms <- list(`rain`    = TR_c ~ WTE + W + rain + rain_7d + rain_30d + open_30d,
                 `no rain` = TR_c ~ WTE + W + open_30d)

# Daily table: wells, drivers and barrier; period labels; 14-day calendar blocks.
cw_df <- wb_daily %>%
  dplyr::select(DATE, TR, WTE, W) %>%
  left_join(drivers_all %>% dplyr::select(DATE, rain, rain_7d, rain_30d, sap_mid, sap_cum30), by = "DATE") %>%
  left_join(barrier_days, by = "DATE") %>%
  arrange(DATE) %>%
  mutate(barrier_open_d = as.integer(!is.na(barrier)),
         open_30d = zoo::rollapplyr(barrier_open_d, 30, sum, partial = TRUE),
         TR_c = pmax(TR, tr_floor),
         cens = TR_c <= tr_floor,
         consec = as.numeric(DATE - lag(DATE)) == 1,
         dTR  = if_else(consec & !cens & !lag(cens), TR - lag(TR), NA_real_),
         dWTE = if_else(consec, WTE - lag(WTE), NA_real_),
         dW   = if_else(consec, W - lag(W), NA_real_),
         period = case_when(DATE >= leafon_start & DATE <= leafon_end ~ "leaf-on",
                            DATE < leafon_start | (DATE > leafon_end & DATE < calib_end) ~ "leaf-off",
                            TRUE ~ "excluded"),
         blk = as.integer(DATE - min(DATE)) %/% cv_block_days) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TR_c), !is.na(WTE), !is.na(W))
calib_all <- filter(cw_df, period == "leaf-off")
leafon <- filter(cw_df, period == "leaf-on")

# Extrapolation check: the leaf-on predictors should lie within the calibration range.
cw_df %>%
  filter(period != "excluded") %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(n_days = n(), n_censored = sum(cens),
            WTE_min = min(WTE), WTE_max = max(WTE), W_min = min(W), W_max = max(W),
            open_30d_max = max(open_30d), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

# Deficit on the leaf-on days for a given prediction (rows must be in date order).
add_deficit <- function(lo, mu) {
  lo %>%
    mutate(pred = mu,
           observed = !cens,
           deficit = if_else(cens, tr_floor - pred, TR_c - pred),   # bound on censored days
           dD = if_else(observed & lag(observed) & as.numeric(DATE - lag(DATE)) == 1,
                        deficit - lag(deficit), NA_real_))
}

# Censored mean of the deficit over a window (intercept-only censored regression).
cens_mean <- function(d) {
  if (sum(d$observed) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  coef(survreg(Surv(deficit, observed, type = "left") ~ 1, data = d, dist = "gaussian"))[["(Intercept)"]]
}

# Tests on a (possibly resampled) leaf-on table.
cw_tests <- function(dd) {
  da <- dd %>% filter(!is.na(sap_cum30)) %>% mutate(sap_z = z(sap_cum30))
  # rain-free days only: on rain days sap flux is low and TR rises faster than WTE
  db <- dd %>% filter(!is.na(dD), !is.na(sap_mid), DATE %in% dry_dates) %>% mutate(sap_z = z(sap_mid))
  c(level_slope_m_per_sd = coef(survreg(Surv(deficit, observed, type = "left") ~ sap_z,
                                        data = da, dist = "gaussian"))[["sap_z"]],
    change_slope_m_per_sd = coef(lm(dD ~ sap_z, data = db))[["sap_z"]],
    measured_deficit_m = cens_mean(filter(dd, DATE <= obs_end)),
    peak_deficit_m = cens_mean(filter(dd, DATE >= peak_start, DATE <= peak_end)))
}

# Point estimate and calendar-block bootstrap (calibration and leaf-on blocks resampled).
run_cw <- function(form, label, R = n_boot_cw) {
  calib <- calib_all %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(all.vars(form)))
  lo <- leafon %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(setdiff(all.vars(form), "TR_c"))) %>% arrange(DATE)
  fit <- fit_tobit(form, calib)
  dd <- add_deficit(lo, predict(fit, newdata = lo, type = "lp"))
  est <- cw_tests(dd)
  rows_c <- split(seq_len(nrow(calib)), calib$blk)
  rows_l <- split(seq_len(nrow(lo)), lo$blk)
  set.seed(42)
  draws <- replicate(R, {
    pc <- sample(names(rows_c), length(rows_c), replace = TRUE)
    pl <- sample(names(rows_l), length(rows_l), replace = TRUE)
    tryCatch(suppressWarnings({
      fb <- fit_tobit(form, calib[unlist(rows_c[pc]), ])
      mu <- predict(fb, newdata = lo, type = "lp")
      list(stats = cw_tests(add_deficit(lo, mu)[unlist(rows_l[pl]), ]), mu = mu)
    }), error = function(e) NULL)
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>% purrr::compact()
  bt <- bind_rows(purrr::map(draws, ~ as_tibble(as.list(.x$stats))))
  mu_bt <- sapply(draws, `[[`, "mu")
  list(label = label, fit = fit, n_calib = nrow(calib), n_calib_cens = sum(calib$cens),
       deficit = dd %>% mutate(pred_low = apply(mu_bt, 1, quantile, 0.025),
                               pred_high = apply(mu_bt, 1, quantile, 0.975)),
       tests = tibble(version = label, term = names(est), estimate = unname(est),
                      ci_low = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      n_boot = sum(!is.na(bt[[names(est)[1]]]))) %>%
         mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high)))
}

cw_results <- purrr::imap(cw_forms, run_cw)

# Calibration models (leaf-off): coefficients and residual scale.
purrr::walk(cw_results, function(r) {
  cat("\nCalibration |", r$label, "| days:", r$n_calib, "| censored:", r$n_calib_cens, "\n")
  print(round(summary(r$fit)$coefficients, 4))
})

# Deficit tests. Expected if the trees lower TR locally: slopes < 0, deficits < 0.
cw_tbl <- bind_rows(purrr::map(cw_results, "tests"))
print(cw_tbl %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), width = Inf)

# (5) Water check: mean deficit of each window as water depth vs cumulative stand
# transpiration from leaf-out to the middle of the window (mean measured E x days; rough).
cum_E_to <- function(day) mean(E_stand$E_mm[E_stand$DATE >= leafon_start & E_stand$DATE <= day]) *
  as.numeric(day - leafon_start + 1)
win_mid <- c(measured_deficit_m = leafon_start + as.numeric(obs_end - leafon_start) / 2,
             peak_deficit_m = peak_start + as.numeric(peak_end - peak_start) / 2)
cw_tbl %>%
  filter(term %in% names(win_mid)) %>%
  mutate(cum_stand_E_mm = purrr::map_dbl(term, ~ cum_E_to(win_mid[[.x]]))) %>%
  transmute(version, window = term,
            deficit_water_mm = round(-estimate * sy * 1000, 1),
            ci_low_mm = round(-ci_high * sy * 1000, 1), ci_high_mm = round(-ci_low * sy * 1000, 1),
            cum_stand_E_mm = round(cum_stand_E_mm, 1),
            ratio_E_to_deficit = round(cum_stand_E_mm / deficit_water_mm, 2)) %>%
  print()

# (6) Placebo: WTE predicted from W, rain and barrier state on leaf-off days (WTE is not
# censored, so ordinary regression; 2024 days, as in the "rain" version).
run_placebo <- function(R = n_boot_cw) {
  form <- WTE ~ W + rain + rain_7d + rain_30d + open_30d
  cal0 <- calib_all %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(all.vars(form)))
  lo <- leafon %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(all.vars(form))) %>% arrange(DATE)
  stats_fun <- function(cal, lo_rows) {
    dd <- lo %>% mutate(deficit = WTE - predict(lm(form, data = cal), newdata = lo))
    dd <- dd[lo_rows, ]
    da <- dd %>% filter(!is.na(sap_cum30)) %>% mutate(sap_z = z(sap_cum30))
    c(level_slope_m_per_sd = coef(lm(deficit ~ sap_z, data = da))[["sap_z"]],
      measured_deficit_m = mean(dd$deficit[dd$DATE <= obs_end]),
      peak_deficit_m = mean(dd$deficit[dd$DATE >= peak_start & dd$DATE <= peak_end]))
  }
  est <- stats_fun(cal0, seq_len(nrow(lo)))
  rows_c <- split(seq_len(nrow(cal0)), cal0$blk)
  rows_l <- split(seq_len(nrow(lo)), lo$blk)
  set.seed(42)
  bt <- bind_rows(replicate(R, {
    pc <- sample(names(rows_c), length(rows_c), replace = TRUE)
    pl <- sample(names(rows_l), length(rows_l), replace = TRUE)
    as_tibble(as.list(stats_fun(cal0[unlist(rows_c[pc]), ], unlist(rows_l[pl]))))
  }, simplify = FALSE))
  tibble(version = "placebo: WTE from W", term = names(est), estimate = unname(est),
         ci_low = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
         ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
         n_boot = nrow(bt)) %>%
    mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high))
}
placebo_cw <- run_placebo()
print(placebo_cw %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), width = Inf)

# (7) Calibration in changes. Daily TR change on WTE and W changes and rain (leaf-off,
# consecutive measured days, 2024 because of rain). Applied to leaf-on from leaf-out to the
# first day TR fell below the sensor; days with a missing change add 0 to the running sum
# (reported as n_days_missing). Tests: drawdown at the end of the window (m and mm) vs
# cumulative stand transpiration, and the daily local change vs sap flux on dry days.
form_chg <- dTR ~ dWTE + dW + rain
first_cens <- min(leafon$DATE[leafon$cens])
lo_chg <- leafon %>% filter(DATE < first_cens) %>% arrange(DATE)
cal_chg <- calib_all %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(all.vars(form_chg)))
chg_stats <- function(cal, lo_rows = seq_len(nrow(lo_chg))) {
  fit <- lm(form_chg, data = cal)
  d <- lo_chg %>%
    mutate(local = dTR - predict(fit, newdata = lo_chg),
           drawdown = cumsum(coalesce(local, 0)))
  ds <- d[lo_rows, ] %>% filter(!is.na(local), !is.na(sap_mid), DATE %in% dry_dates) %>%
    mutate(sap_z = z(sap_mid))
  c(end_drawdown_m = last(d$drawdown),
    change_slope_m_per_sd = coef(lm(local ~ sap_z, data = ds))[["sap_z"]])
}
est_chg <- chg_stats(cal_chg)
rows_c <- split(seq_len(nrow(cal_chg)), cal_chg$blk)
rows_l <- split(seq_len(nrow(lo_chg)), lo_chg$blk)
set.seed(42)
bt_chg <- bind_rows(replicate(n_boot_cw, {
  pc <- sample(names(rows_c), length(rows_c), replace = TRUE)
  pl <- sample(names(rows_l), length(rows_l), replace = TRUE)
  as_tibble(as.list(chg_stats(cal_chg[unlist(rows_c[pc]), ], unlist(rows_l[pl]))))
}, simplify = FALSE))
cat("\nCalibration in changes | leaf-off days:", nrow(cal_chg),
    "| leaf-on window:", format(min(lo_chg$DATE)), "to", format(max(lo_chg$DATE)),
    "| days with missing change:", sum(is.na(lo_chg$dTR)), "\n")
print(round(summary(lm(form_chg, data = cal_chg))$coefficients, 4))
chg_tbl <- tibble(version = "changes", term = names(est_chg), estimate = unname(est_chg),
                  ci_low = purrr::map_dbl(names(est_chg), ~ quantile(bt_chg[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(est_chg), ~ quantile(bt_chg[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  n_boot = nrow(bt_chg)) %>%
  mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high))
print(chg_tbl %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), width = Inf)
chg_tbl %>%
  filter(term == "end_drawdown_m") %>%
  transmute(window_end = max(lo_chg$DATE),
            drawdown_water_mm = round(-estimate * sy * 1000, 1),
            ci_low_mm = round(-ci_high * sy * 1000, 1), ci_high_mm = round(-ci_low * sy * 1000, 1),
            cum_stand_E_mm = round(cum_E_to(max(lo_chg$DATE)), 1),
            ratio_E_to_drawdown = round(cum_stand_E_mm / drawdown_water_mm, 2)) %>%
  print()

# Figure: observed TR vs the level predicted from external hydrology (main "rain"
# version), and the local deficit with the 30-d mean sap flux (rescaled, inverted).
cw_main <- cw_results[["rain"]]$deficit
sap_scale <- diff(range(cw_main$deficit, na.rm = TRUE)) / diff(range(cw_main$sap_cum30, na.rm = TRUE))
fig_cw_a <- ggplot(cw_main, aes(DATE)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred_low, ymax = pred_high), fill = "#2A788EFF", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred, colour = "Predicted from WTE, W, rain, barrier")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = TR_c, colour = "TR observed", shape = cens), size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = tr_floor, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = obs_end, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Predicted from WTE, W, rain, barrier" = "#2A788EFF", "TR observed" = "#7AD151FF")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 6), labels = c("measured", "below sensor")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Water level (m)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL)
fig_cw_b <- ggplot(cw_main, aes(DATE)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = obs_end, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(y = deficit, shape = cens), colour = "black", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = (sap_cum30 - min(sap_cum30, na.rm = TRUE)) * -sap_scale, colour = "30-d sap flux (rescaled, inverted)")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("30-d sap flux (rescaled, inverted)" = "#7AD151FF")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 6), labels = c("deficit", "upper bound (censored)")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Local deficit (m)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL)
fig_cw <- (fig_cw_a / fig_cw_b) & theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
                                        text = element_text(size = 12))
print(fig_cw)
ggsave("fig_control_well_deficit.png", fig_cw, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

# Dry-day recession of the TR water table (leaf-on vs leaf-off, barrier, WTE)

```{r recession-dry-days}
# Is the daily decline of the TR water table on rain-free days faster in leaf-on?
# Uses only consecutive measured days with TR above the sensor (dTR from cw_df).
# (1) GLS with CAR(1) errors, adjusted for the WTE change (first, pre-planned version).
# (2) Days after a barrier opening vs other dry days: barrier pulses reach TR through WTE.
# (3) Same test without the 0-7 days after an opening, with the previous-day level as a
#     covariate (drainage slows when the water table is deeper) and Newey-West (HAC) errors.
#     m_rec2 and rec2 are used by the water budget and the chain chunks.
#     NOTE: (3) was chosen after (1) gave a null result: report it as exploratory and show both.
# (4) Placebo: the same model for WTE (macrophytes). (5) Within leaf-on: VPD vs sap flux.
# Needs cw_df, dry_dates, barrier_open, drivers_all, sy (control-well chunk), z().
p_load(lmtest, sandwich)

rec <- cw_df %>%
  filter(period != "excluded", !is.na(dTR), !is.na(dWTE), DATE %in% dry_dates) %>%
  mutate(leaf = factor(period, levels = c("leaf-off", "leaf-on")),
         day_num = as.numeric(DATE - min(DATE)))

# (1) Extra daily recession in leaf-on, adjusted for WTE
m_rec <- nlme::gls(dTR ~ leaf + dWTE, correlation = nlme::corCAR1(form = ~ day_num), data = rec)
print(summary(m_rec)$tTable)
# Extra recession as water (mm d-1), to compare with stand E (~0.41 mm d-1)
summary(m_rec)$tTable["leafleaf-on", c("Value", "Std.Error")] * sy * 1000

# Within leaf-on: is the dry-day recession faster when trees transpire more?
rec_on <- rec %>% filter(leaf == "leaf-on", !is.na(sap_mid)) %>% mutate(sap_z = z(sap_mid))
print(summary(nlme::gls(dTR ~ sap_z + dWTE, correlation = nlme::corCAR1(form = ~ day_num),
                        data = rec_on))$tTable)

# (2) Recession in the days after a barrier opening vs other dry days (adjusted for WTE)
open_starts <- as.Date(barrier_open$start)
rec <- rec %>%
  mutate(days_since_open = purrr::map_dbl(DATE, function(d) {
           s <- open_starts[open_starts <= d]; if (length(s)) as.numeric(d - max(s)) else NA_real_ }),
         post_open = factor(!is.na(days_since_open) & days_since_open <= 7,
                            levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c("other", "0-7 d after opening")))
m_bar <- nlme::gls(dTR ~ leaf + post_open + dWTE, correlation = nlme::corCAR1(form = ~ day_num), data = rec)
print(summary(m_bar)$tTable)
# Does W also drop after openings? (if yes, drainage reaches the estuary and TR follows)
rec %>% group_by(leaf, post_open) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), dTR_mm = mean(dTR) * 1000, dW_mm = mean(dW, na.rm = TRUE) * 1000, .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

# (3) Without post-opening days, with the previous-day level and HAC errors (exploratory)
rec2 <- rec %>% arrange(DATE) %>%
  left_join(cw_df %>% transmute(DATE = DATE + 1, TR_prev = TR), by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(post_open == "other")
m_rec2 <- lm(dTR ~ leaf + TR_prev + dWTE, data = rec2)
lmtest::coeftest(m_rec2, vcov = sandwich::NeweyWest(m_rec2, prewhite = FALSE))
# Extra leaf-on recession as water (mm d-1)
coef(m_rec2)[["leafleaf-on"]] * sy * 1000

# (4) Same model for WTE (macrophytes): a similar extra summer recession would mean
# general ET, not woody-specific
recW <- cw_df %>% filter(period != "excluded", !is.na(dWTE), !is.na(dW), DATE %in% dry_dates) %>%
  left_join(rec %>% dplyr::select(DATE, post_open), by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(is.na(post_open) | post_open == "other") %>%
  left_join(cw_df %>% transmute(DATE = DATE + 1, WTE_prev = WTE), by = "DATE") %>%
  mutate(leaf = factor(period, levels = c("leaf-off", "leaf-on")))
m_wte <- lm(dWTE ~ leaf + WTE_prev + dW, data = recW)
lmtest::coeftest(m_wte, vcov = sandwich::NeweyWest(m_wte, prewhite = FALSE))

# (5) Within leaf-on: does the dry-day recession follow atmospheric demand (VPD) rather
# than oak sap flux?
rec2_on <- rec2 %>% filter(leaf == "leaf-on") %>%
  left_join(drivers_all %>% dplyr::select(DATE, vpd_max), by = "DATE") %>%
  mutate(sap_z = z(sap_mid), vpd_z = z(vpd_max))
m_on <- lm(dTR ~ TR_prev + vpd_z + sap_z, data = rec2_on)
lmtest::coeftest(m_on, vcov = sandwich::NeweyWest(m_on, prewhite = FALSE))
```

# Summer water budget of TR and root water uptake (skeleton)

```{r water-budget-A-montecarlo}
# A. Partition of the extra leaf-on recession of the TR water table (dry days, no barrier
# opening; m_rec2) into: measured oak transpiration, soil evaporation, change in lateral
# exchange with WTE, and the residual (shrub layer + anything unmeasured).
# Every term is uncertain, so the residual is computed by Monte Carlo: each draw takes one
# value of every input from its plausible range, and the result is reported as a
# distribution (median and 95% interval), never as a single number.
# PLACEHOLDERS (marked TODO) must be replaced with site values.
n_mc <- 10000
set.seed(42)

# (1) Extra recession (m d-1) from m_rec2, with its HAC standard error
rec_vc  <- sandwich::NeweyWest(m_rec2, prewhite = FALSE)
rec_est <- coef(m_rec2)[["leafleaf-on"]]
rec_se  <- sqrt(rec_vc["leafleaf-on", "leafleaf-on"])

# (2) Specific yield: the apparent value from the rain response (0.15) includes interception
# and runoff. TODO: replace the range with the geophysics/texture estimate.
sy_draw <- runif(n_mc, 0.08, 0.25)

# (3) Oak transpiration (mm d-1): measured mean (lower bound) x correction for Granier in
# ring-porous oak and missing sapwood. TODO: justify the range from the literature.
E_oak_meas <- mean(E_stand$E_mm[E_stand$DATE >= leafon_start & E_stand$DATE <= leafon_end])
E_oak_draw <- E_oak_meas * runif(n_mc, 1, 2)

# (4) Soil evaporation under the canopy (mm d-1), Priestley-Taylor on the radiation that
# reaches the ground: E = alpha * s/(s + gamma) * Rn * exp(-k * LAI) / lambda.
# TODO: Rn (MJ m-2 d-1) and air temperature from the OWC met station, LAI of TR.
pt_soil_evap <- function(Rn_MJ, Ta_C, LAI, k = 0.5, alpha = 1.26) {
  s <- 4098 * 0.6108 * exp(17.27 * Ta_C / (Ta_C + 237.3)) / (Ta_C + 237.3)^2  # kPa C-1
  gamma <- 0.066                                                             # kPa C-1
  alpha * s / (s + gamma) * Rn_MJ * exp(-k * LAI) / 2.45                     # mm d-1
}
# Leaf-on minus leaf-off difference, because the recession term is a seasonal difference.
Es_on  <- pt_soil_evap(Rn_MJ = runif(n_mc, 10, 14), Ta_C = 22, LAI = runif(n_mc, 3, 5))   # TODO
Es_off <- pt_soil_evap(Rn_MJ = runif(n_mc, 3, 6),   Ta_C = 8,  LAI = runif(n_mc, 0, 0.5)) # TODO
# No pmax(): under the summer canopy the soil evaporates LESS than in spring/fall, so the
# difference can be negative and must not be cut at 0.
dEs_draw <- (Es_on - Es_off) * runif(n_mc, 0.5, 1)  # soil evaporation is below potential

# (5) Change in lateral exchange with WTE (Darcy), leaf-on minus leaf-off, as an equivalent
# water depth over the TR plot (mm d-1): q = K * b * i / L_plot, with i = head gradient.
# Positive dq = more outflow in summer (adds to the recession); in summer WTE stays high,
# so the gradient may reverse (inflow), which makes the recession UNDER-estimate ET.
# TODO from geophysics: K (m d-1), aquifer thickness b (m), well elevations (dz), distances.
K_draw  <- exp(runif(n_mc, log(0.05), log(5)))   # TODO: replace with measured range
b_draw  <- runif(n_mc, 0.5, 2)                   # TODO
dist_TR_WTE <- 50                                # TODO: m between wells
L_plot  <- 25                                    # m, plot length along the flow
dz_TR_WTE <- 0.85                                # TODO: surveyed elevation difference (m)
grad <- function(per) {
  d <- cw_df %>% filter(period == per)
  mean((d$TR_c + dz_TR_WTE) - d$WTE, na.rm = TRUE) / dist_TR_WTE
}
di <- grad("leaf-on") - grad("leaf-off")
dq_draw <- K_draw * b_draw * di / L_plot * 1000  # mm d-1

# Budget per draw (mm d-1)
budget <- tibble(
  extra_recession = -rnorm(n_mc, rec_est, rec_se) * sy_draw * 1000,
  oak = E_oak_draw, soil_evap = dEs_draw, lateral_change = dq_draw) %>%
  mutate(residual_shrub = extra_recession - oak - soil_evap - lateral_change,
         share_oak = oak / extra_recession, share_soil = soil_evap / extra_recession,
         share_lateral = lateral_change / extra_recession, share_shrub = residual_shrub / extra_recession)

budget %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term") %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(median = median(value), low = quantile(value, 0.025), high = quantile(value, 0.975),
            p_negative = mean(value < 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Which input drives the uncertainty of the residual? (rank correlation per input)
tibble(input = c("recession", "Sy", "oak", "soil_evap", "K", "b"),
       rho = c(cor(budget$extra_recession, budget$residual_shrub, method = "spearman"),
               cor(sy_draw, budget$residual_shrub, method = "spearman"),
               cor(E_oak_draw, budget$residual_shrub, method = "spearman"),
               cor(dEs_draw, budget$residual_shrub, method = "spearman"),
               cor(K_draw, budget$residual_shrub, method = "spearman"),
               cor(b_draw, budget$residual_shrub, method = "spearman"))) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(rho))) %>% print()
```

```{r water-budget-B-experimental-uptake}
# B. Root water uptake measured by the experiment itself (no residual): difference in
# difference of the dry-day SWC change, Control minus Root-free, leaf-on minus leaf-off.
# Root-free soil loses water by evaporation + drainage; Control loses the same plus root
# uptake. If the difference exists only in leaf-on, it is uptake by active roots (shrub +
# trees + herbs together); if it persists in leaf-off, it is soil/disturbance.
# Port level (swc_change_port, Fix 1), port as the unit, 14-day calendar-block bootstrap.
# TODO: layer thickness represented by the SWC sensor (m), e.g. 0.1-0.2 m.
layer_m <- 0.15
did_df <- swc_change_port %>%
  filter(DATE %in% dry_dates, DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end) %>%
  mutate(leaf = factor(if_else(DATE >= leafon_start & DATE <= leafon_end, "leaf-on", "leaf-off"),
                       levels = c("leaf-off", "leaf-on")),
         ctrl = as.numeric(Treat == "Control"),
         ctrl_on = ctrl * (leaf == "leaf-on"),   # Control x leaf-on (ctrl main effect is in PORT)
         blk = as.integer(DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days)
did_coef <- function(d) coef(lm(dswc ~ PORT + leaf + ctrl_on, data = d))[["ctrl_on"]]
did_est <- did_coef(did_df)
rows_b <- split(seq_len(nrow(did_df)), did_df$blk)
set.seed(42)
did_bt <- replicate(1000, {
  pick <- sample(names(rows_b), length(rows_b), replace = TRUE)
  tryCatch(did_coef(did_df[unlist(rows_b[pick]), ]), error = function(e) NA_real_)
})
tibble(term = "Control x leaf-on, dry-day dSWC (m3 m-3 d-1)", estimate = did_est,
       ci_low = quantile(did_bt, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), ci_high = quantile(did_bt, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(uptake_mm_d = -estimate * layer_m * 1000,
         uptake_low = -ci_high * layer_m * 1000, uptake_high = -ci_low * layer_m * 1000) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
# Leaf-off contrast alone (should be ~0 if the treatments do not differ without roots active)
did_df %>% group_by(leaf, Treat) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_dswc = mean(dswc), .groups = "drop") %>% print()

# Per-port leaf-on minus leaf-off dry-day dSWC (each port is one replicate)
port_did <- did_df %>% group_by(PORT, Treat, leaf) %>% summarise(m = mean(dswc), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = leaf, values_from = m) %>%
  mutate(seasonal_change = `leaf-on` - `leaf-off`)
print(port_did)
# Randomization test over the 70 assignments of 4 Control ports
ports8 <- as.character(port_did$PORT)
stat <- function(ctrl_ports) with(port_did, mean(seasonal_change[ports8 %in% ctrl_ports]) -
                                            mean(seasonal_change[!ports8 %in% ctrl_ports]))
obs  <- stat(ports8[port_did$Treat == "Control"])
perm <- vapply(combn(ports8, 4, simplify = FALSE), stat, numeric(1))
c(observed = obs, p_one_sided = mean(perm <= obs + 1e-12))   # smallest possible p = 1/70
```

```{r water-budget-C-ch4}
# C. From water to CH4: seasonal SWC difference caused by root uptake (from B, integrated
# over the leaf-on dry spells) x the SWC -> CH4 slope in Control (path model, Fix 2/3),
```

# Chain: woody-plant ET -> water table -> SWC -> CH4

```{r chain-et-wt-swc-ch4}
# Chain model built from the links that the data can identify, each with the design that
# isolates it, then combined into effects on SWC and CH4 with a joint bootstrap.
#
# Link 1  ET -> water table. "Transpiration" is the extra leaf-on recession of the TR water
#         table (rain-free days, no barrier opening, adjusted for level and WTE; m_rec2),
#         which was specific to the woody plot (no such increase at WTE). It is NOT the
#         sap-flux proxy: sap flux did not track the daily recession. A counterfactual TR
#         without that extra recession is integrated day by day (with the level feedback
#         of the recession model); dWT_ET = observed - counterfactual (m, negative).
#         Steady state of the deficit = b_leaf / b_lvl (about 0.3 m with the current fit).
# Link 2a Water table -> SWC, per treatment (coupling, m3 m-3 per m), daily treatment
#         medians on complete-port days (Fix 1).
# Link 2b Local root uptake -> SWC (Control only): port-level SWC with port and day fixed
#         effects; day effects absorb everything shared (water table, rain, season), so
#         Control x leaf-on is the leaf-on SWC change in Control beyond its water-table
#         coupling (Control x water table is in the model).
# Link 3  SWC (and water table) -> CH4, per treatment, adjusted for soil temperature.
# Effects (leaf-on mean, each treatment):
#   dSWC_wt    = coupling_trt x mean(dWT_ET)
#   dSWC_local = Control x leaf-on (Control only)
#   dCH4       = sw_ch_trt x (dSWC_wt + dSWC_local) + wt_ch_trt x mean(dWT_ET)
# and the Control - Root-free difference, compared with the observed difference in
# difference (leaf-on minus leaf-off, Control minus Root-free) of SWC and CH4 -> % explained.
# Uncertainty: 14-day calendar-block bootstrap over days refitting every link, with one
# member of the gap-fill ensemble (Fix 3) drawn per replicate for the TR water table.
# Port randomization (70 assignments) for the treatment-specific local term.
# Needs m_rec2, rec2, gwl_ens, q_new, wb_daily, resp_daily_4p, swc_daily, cw_df,
# leafon_start, leafon_end, win_start, win_end, cv_block_days.
n_boot_chain <- 500

tr_full_from <- function(values) tibble(DATE = gwl_ens$DATE, TR_full = values)
tr_main <- tr_full_from(q_new[2, ])                        # median of the censored-inside ensemble

# Link 1: counterfactual water table without the extra leaf-on recession.
cf_water_table <- function(tr, b_leaf, b_lvl) {
  d <- tr %>% arrange(DATE) %>% mutate(on = DATE >= leafon_start & DATE <= leafon_end)
  cf <- d$TR_full
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))[-1]) {
    if (!d$on[i]) next
    if (anyNA(c(d$TR_full[i], d$TR_full[i - 1], cf[i - 1]))) { cf[i] <- d$TR_full[i]; next }
    cf[i] <- cf[i - 1] + (d$TR_full[i] - d$TR_full[i - 1]) - b_leaf +
      b_lvl * (cf[i - 1] - d$TR_full[i - 1])
  }
  d %>% mutate(TR_cf = cf, dWT_ET = TR_full - TR_cf)
}

# Data for links 2 and 3 with a given TR series.
link_data <- function(tr) {
  trt <- resp_daily_4p %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, swc, fch4, ts, rain_7d, rain_30d) %>%
    left_join(tr %>% dplyr::select(DATE, gwl = TR_full), by = "DATE") %>%
    mutate(leaf = DATE >= leafon_start & DATE <= leafon_end)
  port <- swc_daily %>%
    keep_complete() %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, PORT, Treat, swc) %>%
    left_join(tr %>% dplyr::select(DATE, gwl = TR_full), by = "DATE") %>%
    filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end, !is.na(gwl)) %>%
    mutate(ctrl = as.numeric(Treat == "Control"),
           ctrl_on = ctrl * (DATE >= leafon_start & DATE <= leafon_end),
           ctrl_gwl = ctrl * gwl,
           blk = as.integer(DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days)
  list(trt = trt, port = port)
}

# All links and effects for one data set. rec_d: recession data; ld: link_data(); tr: TR series.
chain_terms <- function(rec_d, ld, tr) {
  m1 <- lm(dTR ~ leaf + TR_prev + dWTE, data = rec_d)
  b_leaf <- coef(m1)[["leafleaf-on"]]; b_lvl <- coef(m1)[["TR_prev"]]
  cf <- cf_water_table(tr, b_leaf, b_lvl)
  dwt <- mean(cf$dWT_ET[cf$on & cf$DATE >= win_start & cf$DATE <= win_end], na.rm = TRUE)

  out <- c(b_leaf = b_leaf, dWT_ET_mean_m = dwt,
           dWT_ET_max_m = min(cf$dWT_ET[cf$on], na.rm = TRUE))
  # Link 2b: local root effect on SWC (port and day fixed effects)
  pd <- ld$port %>% mutate(fDATE = factor(fDATE_key))
  out[["dSWC_local_C"]] <- coef(lm(swc ~ PORT + fDATE + ctrl_gwl + ctrl_on, data = pd))[["ctrl_on"]]
  for (tr_lab in c("Control", "Root-free")) {
    k <- if (tr_lab == "Control") "C" else "R"
    d <- ld$trt %>% filter(Treat == tr_lab)
    b_sw <- coef(lm(swc ~ gwl + rain_7d + rain_30d + ts, data = tidyr::drop_na(d, swc, gwl, rain_7d, rain_30d, ts)))
    b_ch <- coef(lm(fch4 ~ swc + gwl + ts, data = tidyr::drop_na(d, fch4, swc, gwl, ts)))
    local <- if (k == "C") out[["dSWC_local_C"]] else 0
    dswc_wt <- b_sw[["gwl"]] * dwt
    out[paste0(c("coupling_", "sw_ch_", "wt_ch_", "dSWC_wt_", "dSWC_total_", "dCH4_viaSWC_", "dCH4_total_"), k)] <-
      c(b_sw[["gwl"]], b_ch[["swc"]], b_ch[["gwl"]], dswc_wt, dswc_wt + local,
        b_ch[["swc"]] * (dswc_wt + local), b_ch[["swc"]] * (dswc_wt + local) + b_ch[["gwl"]] * dwt)
  }
  out[["dSWC_diff"]] <- out[["dSWC_total_C"]] - out[["dSWC_total_R"]]
  out[["dCH4_diff"]] <- out[["dCH4_total_C"]] - out[["dCH4_total_R"]]

  # Observed difference in difference (leaf-on minus leaf-off, Control minus Root-free)
  obs <- ld$trt %>% group_by(leaf, Treat) %>%
    summarise(swc = mean(swc, na.rm = TRUE), fch4 = mean(fch4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  g <- function(v, lf, t) obs[[v]][obs$leaf == lf & obs$Treat == t]
  out[["obs_DiD_swc"]]  <- (g("swc", TRUE, "Control") - g("swc", TRUE, "Root-free")) -
                           (g("swc", FALSE, "Control") - g("swc", FALSE, "Root-free"))
  out[["obs_DiD_fch4"]] <- (g("fch4", TRUE, "Control") - g("fch4", TRUE, "Root-free")) -
                           (g("fch4", FALSE, "Control") - g("fch4", FALSE, "Root-free"))
  out[["pct_swc_DiD_explained"]]  <- 100 * out[["dSWC_diff"]] / out[["obs_DiD_swc"]]
  out[["pct_fch4_DiD_explained"]] <- 100 * out[["dCH4_diff"]] / out[["obs_DiD_fch4"]]
  out
}

# Point estimate
ld_main <- link_data(tr_main)
ld_main$port$fDATE_key <- as.character(ld_main$port$DATE)
chain_est <- chain_terms(rec2, ld_main, tr_main)

# Joint bootstrap: calendar blocks of days for every data set, one ensemble member per draw.
rec_b <- rec2 %>% mutate(blk = as.integer(DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days)
set.seed(42)
chain_bt <- bind_rows(replicate(n_boot_chain, {
  tr_k <- tr_full_from(gwl_ens$values[, sample(ncol(gwl_ens$values), 1)])
  ld_k <- link_data(tr_k)
  blks <- sort(unique(ld_k$port$blk))
  pick <- sample(blks, length(blks), replace = TRUE)
  # duplicated blocks keep separate day effects (key = draw position + date)
  ld_k$port <- purrr::map2_dfr(pick, seq_along(pick), function(b, i)
    ld_k$port %>% filter(blk == b) %>% mutate(fDATE_key = paste(i, DATE)))
  trt_blk <- as.integer(ld_k$trt$DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days
  ld_k$trt <- ld_k$trt[unlist(lapply(pick, function(b) which(trt_blk == b))), ]
  rec_k <- rec_b[unlist(lapply(pick, function(b) which(rec_b$blk == b))), ]
  res <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(chain_terms(rec_k, ld_k, tr_k)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res)) NULL else as_tibble(as.list(res))
}, simplify = FALSE))

chain_units <- c(b_leaf = "m d-1", dWT_ET_mean_m = "m", dWT_ET_max_m = "m",
                 dSWC_local = "m3 m-3", coupling = "m3 m-3 per m", sw_ch = "umol m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3",
                 wt_ch = "umol m-2 s-1 per m", dSWC_wt = "m3 m-3", dSWC_total = "m3 m-3",
                 dCH4_viaSWC = "umol m-2 s-1", dCH4_total = "umol m-2 s-1", dSWC_diff = "m3 m-3",
                 dCH4_diff = "umol m-2 s-1", obs_DiD_swc = "m3 m-3", obs_DiD_fch4 = "umol m-2 s-1",
                 pct_swc_DiD_explained = "%", pct_fch4_DiD_explained = "%")
chain_tbl <- tibble(term = names(chain_est), estimate = unname(chain_est),
                    ci_low  = purrr::map_dbl(names(chain_est), ~ quantile(chain_bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(chain_est), ~ quantile(chain_bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    n_boot = nrow(chain_bt)) %>%
  mutate(units = unname(chain_units[sub("_[CR]$", "", term)]),
         ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high))
print(chain_tbl %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Port randomization for the local root term (Control x leaf-on), 70 assignments.
ports_c <- sort(unique(as.character(ld_main$port$PORT)))
ctrl_true <- sort(unique(as.character(ld_main$port$PORT[ld_main$port$Treat == "Control"])))
local_stat <- function(cp) {
  d <- ld_main$port %>%
    mutate(ctrl = as.numeric(as.character(PORT) %in% cp),
           ctrl_on = ctrl * (DATE >= leafon_start & DATE <= leafon_end),
           ctrl_gwl = ctrl * gwl, fDATE = factor(DATE))
  coef(lm(swc ~ PORT + fDATE + ctrl_gwl + ctrl_on, data = d))[["ctrl_on"]]
}
perm_local <- vapply(combn(ports_c, 4, simplify = FALSE), local_stat, numeric(1))
obs_local <- local_stat(ctrl_true)
c(dSWC_local_C = obs_local, p_one_sided = mean(perm_local <= obs_local + 1e-12)) %>% print()

# Figure: observed vs counterfactual TR water table (no extra leaf-on recession).
cf_main <- cf_water_table(tr_main, chain_est[["b_leaf"]],
                          coef(lm(dTR ~ leaf + TR_prev + dWTE, data = rec2))[["TR_prev"]])
fig_cf <- cf_main %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(TR_full, TR_cf), names_to = "series", values_to = "wt") %>%

           fill = "#7AD151FF", alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = tr_floor, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Observed (gap-filled)" = "black",
                                 "Without leaf-on extra recession" = "#2A788EFF")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "TR water table (m)", colour = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", text = element_text(size = 13))
print(fig_cf)
ggsave("fig_counterfactual_water_table.png", fig_cf, width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
