# Rain-event thresholds: when does rain reach the water table and change the SWC–water table–CH4 coupling?

Event-based analysis adapted from Welker et al. (rain garden water budget, J. Sustainable
Water Built Environ., DOI 10.1061/JSWBAY.SWENG-545): split the record into rain events,
measure the response of the TR water table and of SWC to each event, and find the event
size above which rain reaches the water table (breakpoint), separately for barrier open and
closed. The threshold then defines event classes in which the SWC–water table and CH4–SWC
couplings are compared between Control and Root-free, and a per-event budget gives the
water that is not stored (ET + lateral + unmeasured vadose storage), Control vs Root-free.

NOTE: written without running (no R or data in the session where it was written). Check
the object names in "Needs" and run chunk by chunk.

```{r rain-events-table}
# A. Event table.
# Events from DAILY rain (drivers_all$rain, from met_daily, which ends 2024-12-31): a wet day
# has rain >= rain_wet; wet days separated by fewer than min_gap dry days are one event.
# Response window: first wet day to resp_days after the last wet day, cut at the day before
# the next event. Class window (part C): response window + after_days, also cut at the next
# event. Events whose window passes the end of the rain record, or has days without rain
# data, are dropped (an unknown day could hide rain).
# Water table (TR, one well for both treatments), censored at the sensor (tr_floor = -0.49 m):
#   dGW = peak TR in the window - TR on the day before the event.
#   exact        pre and peak above the sensor
#   lower bound  pre below the sensor, peak above: dGW >= peak - floor (right-censored)
#   upper bound  pre above, whole window below: dGW <= floor - pre (left-censored)
#   below sensor pre and peak below the sensor: no information on dGW (dropped from fits,
#                counted in the tables)
# SWC: per port, peak in the window - value on the day before; treatment value = median of
# the port changes, only for events with every port of the treatment (as in Fix 1).
# CH4: treatment daily median on complete days (ch4_4p, Fix 1); dCH4 = mean in the window -
# mean of the 3 days before. CH4 uptake is negative, so dCH4 > 0 = less uptake.
# Needs drivers_all, wb_daily, barrier_days, swc_daily, ch4_4p, n_ports (Fix 1), tr_floor,
# win_start, win_end, leafon_start, leafon_end, cv_block_days; sy (control-well chunk) and
# layer_m (water-budget chunk B) are used if they exist.
p_load(survival, segmented, patchwork)

rain_wet   <- 1      # mm d-1: a day with at least this much rain is wet
min_gap    <- 1      # dry days needed to separate two events (try 2 as a sensitivity)
resp_days  <- 2      # days after the last wet day in the response window
after_days <- 5      # extra days that keep the event's class in part C
min_seg    <- 4      # minimum events on each side of a breakpoint
n_grid     <- 40     # candidate breakpoints per fit
n_boot_ev  <- 500    # bootstrap replicates (1000+ for the paper; each GW fit is ~40 Tobits)
if (!exists("sy")) sy <- 0.15          # apparent specific yield from the water-balance model
if (!exists("layer_m")) layer_m <- 0.15  # TODO: soil layer represented by the SWC sensor (m)
sy_ev   <- c(low = 0.08, model = sy, high = 0.25)
trt_key <- c(Control = "C", `Root-free` = "R")

rain_end <- max(drivers_all$DATE[!is.na(drivers_all$rain)])
cat("Last day with rain data:", format(rain_end), "\n")

# Daily table on a complete calendar (missing days stay as rows with NA).
open_days <- barrier_days %>% distinct(DATE) %>% mutate(open = TRUE)
ev_day <- tibble(DATE = seq(win_start - 10, win_end, by = "day")) %>%
  left_join(drivers_all %>% dplyr::select(DATE, rain), by = "DATE") %>%
  left_join(wb_daily %>% dplyr::select(DATE, TR), by = "DATE") %>%
  left_join(open_days, by = "DATE") %>%
  mutate(open = coalesce(open, FALSE),
         wet  = coalesce(rain >= rain_wet, FALSE),
         TR_c = pmax(TR, tr_floor),
         cens = TR_c <= tr_floor + 1e-9)

# Event boundaries (row indices of ev_day)
wet_i <- which(ev_day$wet)
ev_raw <- tibble(i = wet_i, event = cumsum(c(1, diff(wet_i) - 1 >= min_gap))) %>%
  group_by(event) %>%
  summarise(i_start = min(i), i_end = max(i), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(i_next  = lead(i_start, default = nrow(ev_day) + 1L),
         i_resp  = pmin(i_end + resp_days, i_next - 1L),
         i_class = pmin(i_resp + after_days, i_next - 1L),
         i_pre   = i_start - 1L) %>%
  filter(i_pre >= 7)                                  # 7 days of antecedent rain needed

ev_tbl <- purrr::pmap_dfr(ev_raw, function(event, i_start, i_end, i_next, i_resp, i_class, i_pre) {
  d <- ev_day
  pre <- d$TR_c[i_pre]; pre_c <- d$cens[i_pre]
  w <- d$TR_c[i_start:i_resp]; w <- w[!is.na(w)]
  peak <- if (length(w) > 0) max(w) else NA_real_
  peak_c <- !is.na(peak) && peak <= tr_floor + 1e-9
  type <- if (is.na(pre) || is.na(peak)) "no data" else
    if (!pre_c && !peak_c) "exact" else
    if (pre_c && !peak_c) "lower bound" else
    if (!pre_c && peak_c) "upper bound" else "below sensor"
  tibble(event, start = d$DATE[i_start], end = d$DATE[i_end], resp_end = d$DATE[i_resp],
         class_end = d$DATE[i_class], pre_date = d$DATE[i_pre],
         P = sum(d$rain[i_start:i_end], na.rm = TRUE),
         P_max_day = max(d$rain[i_start:i_end], na.rm = TRUE),
         dur_d = i_end - i_start + 1L,
         ante_7d = sum(d$rain[(i_pre - 6):i_pre], na.rm = TRUE),
         rain_na = sum(is.na(d$rain[(i_pre - 6):i_resp])),
         barrier = if (any(d$open[i_pre:i_resp])) "open" else "closed",
         TR_pre = pre, TR_peak = peak, gw_type = type,
         gw_lo = switch(type, exact = peak - pre, `lower bound` = peak - tr_floor, NA_real_),
         gw_hi = switch(type, exact = peak - pre, `upper bound` = tr_floor - pre, NA_real_))
}) %>%
  filter(start >= win_start, resp_end <= rain_end, rain_na == 0) %>%
  mutate(leaf = if_else(start >= leafon_start & start <= leafon_end, "leaf-on", "leaf-off"))

# Day -> event map: "pre" = day before, "pre3" = 2 days before that (CH4 baseline), "win" = window
ev_map <- purrr::pmap_dfr(ev_tbl %>% dplyr::select(event, pre_date, start, resp_end),
  function(event, pre_date, start, resp_end) {
    win <- seq(start, resp_end, by = "day")
    tibble(event, DATE = c(pre_date - 2, pre_date - 1, pre_date, win),
           role = c("pre3", "pre3", "pre", rep("win", length(win))))
  })

# SWC per port and per treatment (complete events only)
swc_ev_port <- ev_map %>%
  inner_join(swc_daily %>% dplyr::select(DATE, PORT, Treat, swc),
             by = "DATE", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(event, PORT, Treat) %>%
  summarise(swc_pre  = swc[role == "pre"][1],
            swc_peak = if (any(role == "win" & !is.na(swc))) max(swc[role == "win"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(dswc = swc_peak - swc_pre) %>%
  filter(is.finite(dswc))

swc_ev_trt <- swc_ev_port %>%
  left_join(n_ports, by = "Treat") %>%
  group_by(event, Treat) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(PORT) == first(n_ports_trt)) %>%
  summarise(dswc = median(dswc), swc_pre = median(swc_pre), .groups = "drop")

ch4_ev_trt <- ev_map %>%
  inner_join(ch4_4p %>% dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, fch4), by = "DATE", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(event, Treat) %>%
  summarise(ch4_pre = mean(fch4[role != "win"], na.rm = TRUE),
            ch4_win = mean(fch4[role == "win"], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(dch4 = ch4_win - ch4_pre) %>%
  filter(is.finite(dch4))

trt_wide <- full_join(swc_ev_trt, ch4_ev_trt, by = c("event", "Treat")) %>%
  mutate(k = unname(trt_key[Treat])) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Treat) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = k, values_from = c(dswc, swc_pre, ch4_pre, ch4_win, dch4))
ev_tbl <- ev_tbl %>% left_join(trt_wide, by = "event")

# How many events, and how many usable for the water table, per barrier and season.
ev_tbl %>%
  count(barrier, leaf, gw_type) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = gw_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
ev_tbl %>%
  group_by(barrier) %>%
  summarise(n_events = n(), P_median = median(P), P_max = max(P),
            n_dswc_both = sum(!is.na(dswc_C) & !is.na(dswc_R)),
            n_dch4_both = sum(!is.na(dch4_C) & !is.na(dch4_R)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()
```

```{r rain-thresholds}
# B. Thresholds (breakpoints) by event size.
# Hockey-stick model, as in Welker et al.: no response below the threshold psi, linear above:
#   response = base + slope * max(P - psi, 0)
# fitted by profile likelihood over a grid of psi (min_seg events on each side). For the
# water table the fit is a censored (Tobit) regression, so "lower bound" and "upper bound"
# events enter as censored values; for SWC (no censoring) it is ordinary least squares.
# CIs: event bootstrap (stratified by group when two groups are compared), grid fixed at
# the original data. at_edge = share of replicates with psi at the end of the grid; a high
# share means no clear threshold. dll_vs_linear = log-likelihood gain over a straight line
# (> 0 favours a threshold; not a formal test).
# Check: segmented::segmented on the exact events only (ignores censoring, allows a slope
# below the threshold), with the Davies test for a change in slope.
# Groups: none (all events), barrier (open vs closed), leaf (leaf-on vs leaf-off).
# Barrier and season overlap (long winter opening), so read the two splits together.

# Log-likelihood and coefficients of response ~ x (Tobit if any censored event).
fit_ll <- function(d, x) {
  if (all(d$exact)) {
    f <- lm.fit(cbind(1, x), d$lo)
    n <- nrow(d); rss <- sum(f$residuals^2)
    list(ll = -n / 2 * (log(2 * pi * rss / n) + 1), coef = unname(f$coefficients))
  } else {
    dd <- d; dd$x <- x
    m <- survreg(Surv(lo, hi, type = "interval2") ~ x, data = dd, dist = "gaussian")
    list(ll = as.numeric(logLik(m)), coef = unname(coef(m)))
  }
}
psi_grid <- function(P) {
  Ps <- sort(P); k <- length(Ps)
  if (k < 2 * min_seg + 1) return(NULL)
  seq(Ps[min_seg], Ps[k - min_seg], length.out = n_grid)
}
hockey_profile <- function(d, grid) {
  fits <- lapply(grid, function(g) tryCatch(fit_ll(d, pmax(d$P - g, 0)), error = function(e) NULL))
  ll <- vapply(fits, function(f) if (is.null(f)) NA_real_ else f$ll, numeric(1))
  if (all(is.na(ll))) stop("no fit")
  j <- which.max(ll)
  lin <- fit_ll(d, d$P)
  c(psi = grid[j], base = fits[[j]]$coef[1], slope = fits[[j]]$coef[2],
    dll_vs_linear = ll[j] - lin$ll, at_edge = as.numeric(j %in% c(1, length(grid))))
}

boot_events <- function(d, stat_fun, R = n_boot_ev, strata = NULL) {
  idx <- if (is.null(strata)) list(seq_len(nrow(d))) else split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d[[strata]])
  set.seed(42)
  bind_rows(replicate(R, {
    pick <- unlist(lapply(idx, function(ix) ix[sample.int(length(ix), length(ix), replace = TRUE)]))
    s <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(stat_fun(d[pick, ])), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(s)) NULL else as_tibble(as.list(s))
  }, simplify = FALSE))
}
summ_boot <- function(est, bt) {
  tibble(term = names(est), estimate = unname(est),
         ci_low  = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ if (is.null(bt[[.x]])) NA_real_ else quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
         ci_high = purrr::map_dbl(names(est), ~ if (is.null(bt[[.x]])) NA_real_ else quantile(bt[[.x]], 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
         n_boot = nrow(bt))
}

# Response columns -> lo, hi, exact, grp
prep_resp <- function(ev, lo, hi, group = NULL) {
  ev %>%
    mutate(lo = .data[[lo]], hi = .data[[hi]],
           grp = if (is.null(group)) "all" else as.character(.data[[group]])) %>%
    filter(!(is.na(lo) & is.na(hi))) %>%
    mutate(exact = !is.na(lo) & !is.na(hi) & abs(lo - hi) < 1e-12)
}

threshold_tbl <- function(ev, lo, hi, label, group = NULL) {
  d_all <- prep_resp(ev, lo, hi, group)
  purrr::map_dfr(split(d_all, d_all$grp), function(d) {
    info <- tibble(response = label, group_var = if (is.null(group)) "none" else group,
                   group = d$grp[1], n_events = nrow(d), n_censored = sum(!d$exact))
    g <- psi_grid(d$P)
    if (is.null(g)) return(info)                 # too few events for a breakpoint
    est <- hockey_profile(d, g)
    bind_cols(info, summ_boot(est, boot_events(d, function(x) hockey_profile(x, g))))
  })
}

# Difference in psi between the two levels of a group (stratified bootstrap).
threshold_diff <- function(ev, lo, hi, label, group) {
  d <- prep_resp(ev, lo, hi, group)
  lv <- sort(unique(d$grp))
  grids <- lapply(lv, function(l) psi_grid(d$P[d$grp == l]))
  if (length(lv) != 2 || any(vapply(grids, is.null, logical(1)))) return(NULL)
  stat <- function(x) c(psi_diff = hockey_profile(filter(x, grp == lv[1]), grids[[1]])[["psi"]] -
                                   hockey_profile(filter(x, grp == lv[2]), grids[[2]])[["psi"]])
  summ_boot(stat(d), boot_events(d, stat, strata = "grp")) %>%
    mutate(response = label, contrast = paste(lv[1], "-", lv[2]), .before = 1)
}

seg_check <- function(ev, lo, hi, label, group = NULL) {
  d_all <- prep_resp(ev, lo, hi, group) %>% filter(exact)
  purrr::map_dfr(split(d_all, d_all$grp), function(d) {
    if (nrow(d) < 2 * min_seg + 1) return(tibble(response = label, group = d$grp[1], n_exact = nrow(d)))
    m0 <- lm(lo ~ P, data = d)
    ms <- tryCatch(segmented(m0, seg.Z = ~P, psi = median(d$P)), error = function(e) NULL)
    tibble(response = label, group = d$grp[1], n_exact = nrow(d),
           psi_seg = if (is.null(ms)) NA_real_ else ms$psi[1, "Est."],
           psi_se  = if (is.null(ms)) NA_real_ else ms$psi[1, "St.Err"],
           davies_p = tryCatch(davies.test(m0, seg.Z = ~P)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_))
  })
}

# B1. Recharge threshold: water table
gw_thr <- bind_rows(threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)"),
                    threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)", "barrier"),
                    threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)", "leaf"))
print(gw_thr %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), n = Inf, width = Inf)
gw_thr_diff <- bind_rows(threshold_diff(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)", "barrier"),
                         threshold_diff(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)", "leaf"))
if (nrow(gw_thr_diff) > 0) {
  print(gw_thr_diff %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 1))), width = Inf)
} else cat("Too few events in one group for a threshold difference.\n")
bind_rows(seg_check(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)"),
          seg_check(ev_tbl, "gw_lo", "gw_hi", "dGW (m)", "barrier")) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

# B2. SWC response threshold, per treatment. If roots intercept small storms, the Control
# threshold is higher than the Root-free one (psi_diff C - R > 0).
swc_thr <- bind_rows(
  threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "dswc_C", "dswc_C", "dSWC Control"),
  threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "dswc_R", "dswc_R", "dSWC Root-free"),
  threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "dswc_C", "dswc_C", "dSWC Control", "leaf"),
  threshold_tbl(ev_tbl, "dswc_R", "dswc_R", "dSWC Root-free", "leaf"))
print(swc_thr %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))), n = Inf, width = Inf)

# Paired Control - Root-free difference in psi (same events in every replicate)
ev_both <- ev_tbl %>% filter(!is.na(dswc_C), !is.na(dswc_R))
g_C <- psi_grid(ev_both$P)
psi_ctrl_minus_rf <- function(x) {
  dc <- x %>% mutate(lo = dswc_C, hi = dswc_C, exact = TRUE)
  dr <- x %>% mutate(lo = dswc_R, hi = dswc_R, exact = TRUE)
  c(psi_diff_C_minus_R = hockey_profile(dc, g_C)[["psi"]] - hockey_profile(dr, g_C)[["psi"]])
}
if (!is.null(g_C)) {
  summ_boot(psi_ctrl_minus_rf(ev_both), boot_events(ev_both, psi_ctrl_minus_rf)) %>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>% print()
}
```

```{r rain-coupling-classes}
# C. Couplings by event class.
# Event size class from the pooled water-table threshold (psi_class, mm; set psi_manual
# to override, e.g. with a round value or the closed-barrier estimate). Each day from the
# start of an event to class_end gets the event's class (size x barrier); other days are
# "no event". Days after the end of the rain record are dropped (cannot be classified).
# C1 (daily): per treatment and class, SWC ~ water table (coupling, m3 m-3 per m) and
#     CH4 ~ SWC + soil temperature (umol m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3), and Control - Root-free.
#     Water table = median of the censored-inside gap-fill ensemble (Fix 3) if present,
#     else gwl_fill; sensitivity with measured water-table days only (TR above sensor).
#     CIs: 14-day calendar-block bootstrap, same days for both treatments.
#     Classes pool seasons; a class with few days gives wide or missing estimates.
# C2 (event level): across exact events, dSWC ~ dGW and dCH4 ~ dSWC per treatment and
#     size class (event bootstrap, stratified by size).
min_days_cls <- 15
min_ev_cls   <- 6
psi_class <- if (exists("psi_manual")) psi_manual else
  gw_thr %>% filter(group_var == "none", term == "psi") %>% pull(estimate)
if (length(psi_class) != 1 || is.na(psi_class)) stop("No pooled water-table threshold: set psi_manual (mm).")
cat("Size threshold used for the classes:", round(psi_class, 1), "mm\n")

ev_tbl <- ev_tbl %>%
  mutate(size = if_else(P >= psi_class, "large", "small"),
         class = paste(size, barrier, sep = ", "))

day_class <- purrr::pmap_dfr(ev_tbl %>% dplyr::select(start, class_end, class),
                             function(start, class_end, class)
                               tibble(DATE = seq(start, class_end, by = "day"), class = class))

gwl_day <- if (exists("q_new") && exists("gwl_ens")) {
  tibble(DATE = gwl_ens$DATE, gwl = q_new[2, ])
} else {
  resp_daily_4p %>% distinct(DATE, gwl = gwl_fill)
}

cpl_df <- resp_daily_4p %>%
  dplyr::select(DATE, Treat, swc, fch4, ts) %>%
  left_join(gwl_day, by = "DATE") %>%
  left_join(ev_day %>% transmute(DATE, gw_obs = !cens), by = "DATE") %>%
  left_join(day_class, by = "DATE") %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= rain_end) %>%
  mutate(class = coalesce(class, "no event"),
         blk = as.integer(DATE - win_start) %/% cv_block_days)
cls_levels <- sort(unique(cpl_df$class))

cpl_df %>%
  distinct(DATE, class, gw_obs) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(n_days = n(), n_days_wt_measured = sum(gw_obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

coupling_terms <- function(dd) {
  out <- c()
  for (cl in cls_levels) {
    for (tr in names(trt_key)) {
      k <- trt_key[[tr]]
      d  <- dd %>% filter(class == cl, Treat == tr)
      d1 <- tidyr::drop_na(d, swc, gwl)
      d2 <- tidyr::drop_na(d, fch4, swc, ts)
      out[paste0("wt_sw_", k, "|", cl)] <-
        if (n_distinct(d1$DATE) >= min_days_cls) coef(lm(swc ~ gwl, data = d1))[["gwl"]] else NA_real_
      out[paste0("sw_ch_", k, "|", cl)] <-
        if (n_distinct(d2$DATE) >= min_days_cls) coef(lm(fch4 ~ swc + ts, data = d2))[["swc"]] else NA_real_
    }
    out[paste0("wt_sw_diff|", cl)] <- out[[paste0("wt_sw_C|", cl)]] - out[[paste0("wt_sw_R|", cl)]]
    out[paste0("sw_ch_diff|", cl)] <- out[[paste0("sw_ch_C|", cl)]] - out[[paste0("sw_ch_R|", cl)]]
  }
  out
}

boot_blocks <- function(dd, stat_fun, R = n_boot_ev) {
  rows <- split(seq_len(nrow(dd)), dd$blk)
  set.seed(42)
  bind_rows(replicate(R, {
    pick <- sample(names(rows), length(rows), replace = TRUE)
    s <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(stat_fun(dd[unlist(rows[pick]), ])), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(s)) NULL else as_tibble(as.list(s))
  }, simplify = FALSE))
}

run_coupling <- function(dd, version) {
  summ_boot(coupling_terms(dd), boot_blocks(dd, coupling_terms)) %>%
    tidyr::separate(term, c("stat", "class"), sep = "\\|") %>%
    mutate(version = version, ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high), .before = 1)
}
cpl_tbl <- bind_rows(
  run_coupling(cpl_df, "all days"),
  run_coupling(filter(cpl_df, gw_obs %in% TRUE), "water table measured"))
# The wt_sw rows of "water table measured" are the clean ones (no gap-fill); its sw_ch rows
# only use fewer days.
print(cpl_tbl %>% mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
        arrange(version, stat, class), n = Inf, width = Inf)

# C2. Event-level couplings (exact water-table events for dSWC ~ dGW)
ev_cpl_terms <- function(x) {
  out <- c()
  for (sz in c("small", "large")) for (k in trt_key) {
    a <- x %>% filter(size == sz, gw_type == "exact") %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(paste0("dswc_", k)))
    b <- x %>% filter(size == sz) %>% tidyr::drop_na(all_of(c(paste0("dswc_", k), paste0("dch4_", k))))
    out[paste0("dswc_on_dgw_", k, "|", sz)] <- if (nrow(a) >= min_ev_cls)
      unname(coef(lm(a[[paste0("dswc_", k)]] ~ a$gw_lo))[2]) else NA_real_
    out[paste0("dch4_on_dswc_", k, "|", sz)] <- if (nrow(b) >= min_ev_cls)
      unname(coef(lm(b[[paste0("dch4_", k)]] ~ b[[paste0("dswc_", k)]]))[2]) else NA_real_
  }
  out
}
ev_cpl_est <- ev_cpl_terms(ev_tbl)
summ_boot(ev_cpl_est, boot_events(ev_tbl, ev_cpl_terms, strata = "size")) %>%
  tidyr::separate(term, c("stat", "size"), sep = "\\|") %>%
  left_join(ev_tbl %>% count(size, name = "n_events"), by = "size") %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

```{r rain-event-budget}
# D. Per-event budget, as in Welker et al.
# loss = P - Sy * dGW - layer * dSWC   (mm; everything not stored in the water table or in
# the sensor layer: ET + lateral outflow + storage in the unmeasured vadose zone).
# Uses exact water-table events only, for three Sy values (low, water-balance model, high).
# Treatment contrast: dGW is the same for both treatments (one well), so it cancels:
#   loss_C - loss_R = layer * (dSWC_R - dSWC_C) * 1000  (mm)
# This needs no Sy and no well data, so it uses every event with complete ports.
# > 0 = Control stored less of the same rain (root interception/uptake, or other soil
# differences). Inference: event bootstrap stratified by size, and per-port randomization
# (70 assignments of 4 Control ports) on the mean port dSWC over small and large events.
# The response of SWC also depends on how wet the soil was before the event; the pre-event
# SWC of each treatment is printed so that this can be judged.

loss_ev <- ev_tbl %>%
  filter(gw_type == "exact", !is.na(dswc_C), !is.na(dswc_R)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(sy_case = names(sy_ev)) %>%
  mutate(sy_val = unname(sy_ev[sy_case]),
         gw_mm = sy_val * gw_lo * 1000,
         swc_mm_C = layer_m * dswc_C * 1000, swc_mm_R = layer_m * dswc_R * 1000,
         loss_C = P - gw_mm - swc_mm_C, loss_R = P - gw_mm - swc_mm_R,
         frac_loss_C = loss_C / P, frac_loss_R = loss_R / P)
loss_ev %>%
  group_by(sy_case, size) %>%
  summarise(n_events = n(), P_median = median(P), gw_mm = median(gw_mm),
            frac_loss_C = median(frac_loss_C), frac_loss_R = median(frac_loss_R), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  print()

# Treatment contrast (no Sy)
dloss_terms <- function(x) {
  x <- x %>% mutate(dloss = layer_m * (dswc_R - dswc_C) * 1000)
  s <- mean(x$dloss[x$size == "small"]); l <- mean(x$dloss[x$size == "large"])
  c(dloss_small_mm = s, dloss_large_mm = l, large_minus_small = l - s,
    dloss_frac_small = mean(x$dloss[x$size == "small"] / x$P[x$size == "small"]),
    dloss_frac_large = mean(x$dloss[x$size == "large"] / x$P[x$size == "large"]))
}
summ_boot(dloss_terms(ev_both %>% left_join(ev_tbl %>% dplyr::select(event, size), by = "event")),
          boot_events(ev_both %>% left_join(ev_tbl %>% dplyr::select(event, size), by = "event"),
                      dloss_terms, strata = "size")) %>%
  mutate(ci_excludes_0 = sign(ci_low) == sign(ci_high),
         across(c(estimate, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
ev_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(dswc_C), !is.na(dswc_R)) %>%
  group_by(size, leaf) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), swc_pre_C = mean(swc_pre_C), swc_pre_R = mean(swc_pre_R),
            dswc_C = mean(dswc_C), dswc_R = mean(dswc_R), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  print()

# Port randomization: events with all ports present; statistic = mean of Control ports -
# mean of Root-free ports of the per-port mean dSWC, in mm of the sensor layer.
n_all_ports <- sum(n_ports$n_ports_trt)
port_ev <- swc_ev_port %>%
  group_by(event) %>% filter(n_distinct(PORT) == n_all_ports) %>% ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(ev_tbl %>% dplyr::select(event, size), by = "event") %>%
  mutate(PORT = as.character(PORT))
port_mean <- port_ev %>% group_by(PORT, Treat, size) %>% summarise(dswc = mean(dswc), n_ev = n(), .groups = "drop")
ports_all  <- sort(unique(port_mean$PORT))
ports_ctrl <- sort(unique(port_mean$PORT[port_mean$Treat == "Control"]))
rand_stat <- function(cp, sz) {
  d <- filter(port_mean, size == sz)
  (mean(d$dswc[d$PORT %in% cp]) - mean(d$dswc[!d$PORT %in% cp])) * layer_m * 1000
}
assign_all <- combn(ports_all, length(ports_ctrl), simplify = FALSE)
purrr::map_dfr(c("small", "large"), function(sz) {
  perm <- vapply(assign_all, rand_stat, numeric(1), sz = sz)
  obs <- rand_stat(ports_ctrl, sz)
  tibble(size = sz, n_events = n_distinct(port_ev$event[port_ev$size == sz]),
         C_minus_R_mm = round(obs, 2),
         p_one_sided_C_lower = mean(perm <= obs + 1e-12), n_assignments = length(perm))
}) %>% print()
print(port_mean %>% mutate(dswc = round(dswc, 4)) %>% arrange(size, Treat, PORT), n = Inf)
```

```{r rain-threshold-figures}
# E. Figures: dGW and dSWC against event rain, with the fitted hockey sticks.
hockey_lines <- function(thr, gv) {
  thr %>%
    filter(group_var == gv, term %in% c("psi", "base", "slope")) %>%
    dplyr::select(response, group, term, estimate) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(P = seq(0, max(ev_tbl$P), length.out = 200)) %>%
    mutate(fit = base + slope * pmax(P - psi, 0))
}

gw_pts <- ev_tbl %>%
  filter(gw_type %in% c("exact", "lower bound", "upper bound")) %>%
  mutate(y = if_else(gw_type == "upper bound", gw_hi, gw_lo))
gw_lines <- hockey_lines(gw_thr, "barrier") %>% rename(barrier = group)
fig_gw <- ggplot(gw_pts, aes(P, y, colour = barrier)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = gw_type), size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = gw_lines, aes(P, fit), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(data = distinct(gw_lines, barrier, psi), aes(xintercept = psi, colour = barrier),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(closed = "#2A788EFF", open = "#E3A72FFF")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(exact = 16, `lower bound` = 2, `upper bound` = 6),
                     labels = c(exact = "measured", `lower bound` = "at least (pre below sensor)",
                                `upper bound` = "at most (stayed below sensor)")) +
  labs(x = "Event rain (mm)", y = "Water-table rise, TR (m)", colour = "Barrier", shape = NULL)

swc_pts <- ev_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(event, P, Control = dswc_C, `Root-free` = dswc_R) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(Control, `Root-free`), names_to = "Treat", values_to = "dswc") %>%
  filter(!is.na(dswc))
swc_lines <- hockey_lines(swc_thr, "none") %>% mutate(Treat = sub("^dSWC ", "", response))
fig_swc <- ggplot(swc_pts, aes(P, dswc, colour = Treat)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = swc_lines, aes(P, fit), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(data = distinct(swc_lines, Treat, psi), aes(xintercept = psi, colour = Treat),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Control = "#7AD151FF", `Root-free` = "#414487FF")) +
  labs(x = "Event rain (mm)", y = expression(SWC~rise~(m^3~m^-3)), colour = NULL)

fig_rain_thr <- (fig_gw / fig_swc) & theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
                                      text = element_text(size = 12))
print(fig_rain_thr)
ggsave("fig_rain_thresholds.png", fig_rain_thr, width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
